products.name: Odyssey TRTL Max S2S Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers seeking maximum stability and a square-to-square putting motion, the Odyssey TRTL Max S2S Putter is ideal for players who prefer a center-shafted, zero-torque setup that helps minimize unwanted face rotation throughout the stroke. The larger TRTL MAX mallet shape provides maximum MOI for added forgiveness and confidence, while Twin Track alignment gives players who aim best with a long, uninterrupted line an intuitive visual reference. The Ai-Star insert complements the stable design with consistent ball speed, improved forward roll, and the signature Odyssey feel.
The Tech Story
The Odyssey TRTL Max S2S Putter combines advanced multi-material construction, precision weighting, and performance-driven alignment and roll technologies to deliver exceptional stability, forgiveness, and consistency in a modern mallet design. A premium black PVD-finished steel body works with a lightweight ABS shell and aerospace-grade aluminum sole to push weight toward the perimeter, maximizing MOI for greater stability and forgiveness, while four discrete corner weights provide extensive adjustability by allowing the center of gravity to be shifted forward, rearward, heelward, or toeward to fine-tune performance characteristics, with separately sold weight kits offering further customization. Twin Track Alignment provides a long, uninterrupted visual reference for players who prefer this style of aiming, while all-new sole geometry uses refined rake and camber to help the head sit naturally square and flush to the ground at address, promoting more confident alignment and a consistent setup. The AI-designed Ai-Star insert features a dual-layer construction with an aluminum inner layer and firmer urethane striking surface to deliver consistent ball speed and enhanced forward roll across the face while maintaining the signature feel of an Odyssey insert. Working in conjunction with the dual-layer insert, the deeper and more aggressive F.R.D. Forward Roll Design groove features a 19° slope to further improve forward roll on strikes up and down the face. Completing the design, a Tour-developed Pistol grip features crisp, comfortable edges that enhance awareness of the putter face throughout the stroke, while the Tour-preferred SL 120 shaft is finished in black PVD to complement the head and provide a clean, premium appearance.
Facts and Figures
Head Style: Mallet
Neck Type: Center Shaft
Alignment: Twin Track
Material: lightweight ABS, aerospace-grade aluminum
Finish: Black PVD
Headcover: Odyssey TRTL Max Mallet

Designed for golfers who appreciate the classic look and feel of a premium putter but want the flexibility to fine-tune performance, the Mizuno M.Craft X S3 Putter blends traditional craftsmanship with modern adjustability. Its precision-forged construction delivers exceptional feel and feedback, while the fully adjustable design allows players to customize the putter to match their stroke and preferences. Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who want to sharpen their short game performance and gain greater confidence around the greens, the Tour Edge Exotics Milled Wedge is ideal for players focused on precision, versatility, and control. Engineered to optimize contact, trajectory, and spin, it caters to golfers who demand consistent results on everything from full approach shots to delicate finesse shots, helping them execute a wider variety of scoring shots with confidence and accuracy.

Precision CNC-milled Superspin™ grooves utilize steeper groove walls, advanced face texturing, and tighter edge tolerances to maximize friction at impact, generating exceptional spin and control on scoring shots. Guided by feedback from Srixon’s tour staff, the ZXi7 features Refined Players Shaping with thinner toplines and a cleaner, more precise look at address, while every head is precision forged by Endo in Japan, widely regarded as the industry benchmark for premium iron forging and uncompromising feel.

products.name: Callaway Full Toe SP Wedge
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for skilled golfers who like to manipulate the clubface around the greens, the Callaway Full Toe SP Wedge is ideal for players who frequently open the face to hit specialty shots and demand consistent spin from a variety of lies. The full-face Spin Gen 2.0 groove pattern, featuring 44% more groove area than traditional 60° wedges, helps deliver high spin and aggressive stopping power even on off-center strikes. Combined with a refined head shape, optimized center of gravity weighting, and Spin Pocket™ construction, it excels in bunker play and short-game situations where versatility, precision, and control are essential.
The Tech Story
The Callaway Full Toe SP Wedge is engineered to maximize short-game spin, versatility, and shot-making confidence through a combination of advanced shaping and performance-driven technologies. Its new Full Toe design features increased face area and enhanced toe height, giving golfers more confidence and forgiveness when opening the face for delicate pitches, flop shots, and bunker escapes. Full Face Spin Gen 2.0 grooves extend from heel to toe, providing 44% more groove area than a conventional 60° wedge and utilizing a 17° tighter groove pitch to create greater groove-edge contact, higher spin rates, and aggressive stopping power across a larger hitting surface. Callaway’s innovative Spin Pocket™ construction strategically removes mass low in the head and relocates it higher, producing the highest center of gravity ever used in a Callaway wedge to increase spin generation and improve performance on open-face shots. To further enhance versatility, the wedge is offered in two specialized sole configurations: the J Grind, which combines lower effective bounce, aggressive heel relief, and added camber for creative shot-making while maintaining stability on full swings, and the JW Grind, available in 62°, which incorporates a wider sole and higher bounce to make bunker play easier without sacrificing greenside versatility. Together, these technologies create a wedge built for golfers who demand maximum spin, control, and adaptability from every short-game situation.

Designed for advanced junior golfers seeking tour-level iron performance, the US Kids Golf Tour Series 6 66" Iron Set is ideal for competitive players who want greater ball speed, distance, consistency, and overall shot-making versatility. Developed using thousands of TrackMan data points and extensive product research, it is built for young golfers who are serious about improving their game and competing at a higher level. The U.S. Kids Golf Tour Series 6 66" Iron Set is engineered to deliver tour-inspired performance, forgiveness, and player development through advanced materials and precision fitting. products.name: Evnroll EZPZ Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who want greater stability and consistency on the greens without having to change their natural putting stroke, the Evnroll EZPZ Putter is ideal for players who struggle with face rotation and inconsistent strike quality. Its Reverse Torque technology helps keep the face squarer through impact, extending the effective Square Zone for more forgiving performance, while SweetFace 2.0 promotes improved distance control and tighter dispersion across the face. Players seeking more confidence on short and mid-range putts, along with more predictable roll and reduced dimple deflection, will benefit from its advanced stability-focused design.
The Tech Story
The Evnroll EZPZ Putter combines advanced multi-material construction with innovative face and hosel technologies to deliver exceptional stability, consistency, and feel on the greens. Built around a precision-milled 6061 aluminum chassis with 100% milled 303 stainless steel weight wings, the putter strategically positions mass to maximize forgiveness while maintaining a premium, sleek black finish and a high-performance Evnroll/UST Mamiya All-In shaft. At its core is SweetFace 2.0 technology, featuring precision-engineered parabolic groove patterns that promote consistent, tour-preferred ball speeds across the face, ensuring uniform roll distances on center and off-center strikes while reducing dispersion, counteracting CG-related miss-hit tendencies, and eliminating potential dimple deflection. The innovative Reverse Torque Hosel maintains a traditional offset appearance at address while utilizing a forward-leaning design that positions the shaft axis toe-ward of the center of gravity, creating a heel-down balance with 60% of the clubhead’s mass located beneath the shaft axis. This unique configuration controls face rotation without eliminating face awareness, expanding the effective square zone up to twice that of traditional putter designs for greater consistency through impact. Complementing these technologies, optimized weighting places fully milled steel weights in the extreme heel and toe to increase stability and MOI, while swing weight balancing at every shaft length ensures a consistently smooth feel and performance regardless of build specifications.

Neck Type: Reverse Torque
Alignment: Single Top Dot with Dual Back Cavity Lines
Material: 100% Milled 6061 aluminum chassis and 303 stainless steel weight wings

products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who want precise yardages, improved course management, and greater confidence over every shot, the Garmin Approach Z10 Rangefinder is an excellent fit for players of all skill levels who value accurate distance information and modern GPS integration. Its ability to measure targets up to 350 yards away with 6X magnification, provide elevation-adjusted PlaysLike Distance, and display front-, middle-, and back-of-green information when paired with compatible Garmin devices makes it especially appealing to golfers seeking a more informed and strategic approach to the game. The Range Relay feature further enhances the experience by displaying ranged distances directly on a course map through a compatible smartwatch, handheld device, or the Garmin Golf app, helping players visualize hazards, landing areas, and targets with greater clarity as they move through the course.
The Tech Story
The Garmin Approach Z10 combines advanced laser rangefinder precision with powerful GPS connectivity to provide a more complete view of every shot on the course. Its innovative Range Relay feature syncs ranged distances to a compatible Garmin smartwatch, handheld device, or the Garmin Golf™ app, displaying a laser range arc on a course map to reveal hazards, landing areas, and everything in play. PlaysLike Distance technology adjusts yardages based on elevation changes, giving golfers a more accurate understanding of how uphill and downhill shots are truly playing. Through the viewfinder, players can also see the distance from the pin to the front and back of the green, offering valuable context for club selection and approach strategy. A built-in magnetic cart mount keeps the device conveniently accessible during the round, while Tournament Mode includes an external indicator light to clearly signal compliance with competition rules. For added peace of mind, Find My Garmin integration allows users to locate a misplaced rangefinder through the Garmin Golf app, making the Approach Z10 a feature-rich solution for golfers seeking precise measurements, smarter course management, and seamless integration with the Garmin ecosystem.

Who’s It For?
Designed for skilled golfers who thrive on creativity around the greens, the Cleveland RTZ 2 Tour Rack Full Face Wedge is ideal for players who frequently open the face to hit high, soft shots, delicate flops, and specialty pitches. The ADAPT Full-Face design features an enlarged face, extended toe shape, and longer grooves to maintain consistent spin, trajectory, and stopping power even when impact moves higher on the face or toward the toe during open-face swings. The Tech Story
The Cleveland RTZ 2 Tour Rack Full Face Wedge combines premium materials and advanced spin technologies to deliver exceptional short game control, consistency, and feel. At the heart of the design is ZipCore iQ technology, which uses loft- and grind-specific lightweight hosel cores to strategically redistribute mass, increasing stability and improving performance on both center and off-center strikes. The wedge is crafted from Cleveland’s proprietary Z-Alloy steel, a softer, less dense, and highly durable material that enhances feel while providing greater forgiveness and consistency throughout the scoring zone. HydraZip technology utilizes specialized face blasting and laser-milled patterns to maximize spin retention in wet conditions while balancing performance across different lofts, ensuring reliable control regardless of the weather. UltiZip grooves feature sharper edges and increased depth to effectively channel away grass, sand, dirt, and moisture at impact, generating stronger and more consistent spin from the fairway, rough, and bunker. Completing the package, Rotex Milling creates a precisely roughened face texture that promotes predictable spin rates, increased stopping power, and exceptional shot control, making the RTZ 2 Tour Rack Full Face Wedge a tour-caliber scoring club built for confidence and precision in any condition.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for discerning golfers who demand the ultimate in premium craftsmanship, precision, and feel, the Odyssey Damascus Milled Jailbird Mini DB Putter is an excellent fit for players who prefer the feedback and consistency of a fully milled design. The face-balanced configuration with a double bend shaft and 3/4 shaft offset makes it especially well-suited for golfers with a minimal arc putting stroke, helping promote a more stable, straight-back-straight-through motion. Its iconic Jailbird Mini shape provides confidence at address, while the exclusive Damascus Steel insert delivers a uniquely soft and responsive feel that appeals to players seeking both elite performance and a truly distinctive, limited-edition putter experience.
The Tech Story
The Odyssey Damascus Milled Jailbird Mini DB Putter represents the pinnacle of premium putter craftsmanship, combining traditional forging techniques with cutting-edge performance technology. At its core is a one-of-a-kind Damascus Steel insert created through a meticulous process of forging, folding, and pressing multiple steel alloys into a layered structure that produces a distinctive pattern unique to every putter. Enhanced by a specialized heat treatment and AI-designed contours on the back surface, the insert delivers exceptionally responsive feel while promoting consistent ball speeds across the face for improved distance control. The head itself is 100% precision milled from premium stainless steel, showcasing refined shaping, tight tolerances, and elite-level craftsmanship. A sophisticated blasted silver finish complements the Damascus insert and sole plates, creating a timeless, understated appearance. Performance is further enhanced by the new Rubber Tour Pistol Grip, developed alongside Golf Pride and refined through tour player feedback to provide exceptional comfort and control, while the lightweight SL90 steel shaft incorporates a 20-gram counterbalance weight in the butt section to improve stability, tempo, and consistency throughout the putting stroke.

products.name: Ping Scottsdale TEC Ketsch 4 Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers with a strong arc in their putting stroke who prefer the stability of a larger mallet design, the Ping Scottsdale TEC Ketsch 4 Putter combines tour-inspired performance with advanced alignment assistance to help improve accuracy and consistency on the greens. The Anser 4-style hosel creates increased toe hang, making it an ideal fit for players who naturally rotate the putter through impact, while Eye Q Technology and multiple alignment lines simplify setup and aiming. Golfers seeking enhanced distance control, a softer feel, and confidence-inspiring alignment features will benefit most from this innovative design developed through PING’s extensive tour feedback and Putting Lab research.
The Tech Story
The PING Scottsdale TEC Ketsch 4 Putter combines advanced alignment science, high-MOI forgiveness, and responsive feel in a tour-inspired mallet design engineered to help golfers putt more consistently. At the heart of the putter is Eye-Q Technology, developed using the proven Quiet Eye eye-tracking technique, which places a distinct focal-point dot on the top rail alongside a long alignment line to help golfers stabilize their gaze and improve aim throughout the stroke. The Ketsch 4’s onset hosel design positions the shaft near the center line of the head, behind the top rail and in front of the center of gravity, providing a full-face view of the ball for easier alignment while ensuring the CG remains behind the shaft axis for enhanced stability and the natural feel of a strong-arc stroke. A one-piece PEBAX insert delivers a soft yet responsive impact sensation and consistent distance control, utilizing the same high-energy-return elastomer commonly found in premium athletic footwear. To maximize forgiveness, the putter pairs a lightweight aluminum body with a dense stainless steel sole plate, strategically positioning mass low and around the perimeter to create extreme MOI and an optimized CG for greater stability and more consistent roll. Additional weight savings from the insert cavity allow for further performance tuning, making the Scottsdale TEC Ketsch 4 a highly forgiving, alignment-focused mallet designed to inspire confidence on the greens.

products.name: Titleist GTS3 Fairway Wood
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for players who consistently strike down on the ball and demand precise long-range performance, the Titleist GTS3 Fairway Wood is ideal for golfers seeking a penetrating, high launch with controlled spin from the fairway. Its deeper face profile promotes confident ball-striking and improved center-face contact, making it especially appealing for those with a descending attack angle. With added adjustability through interchangeable heel-toe weighting, it suits players who want to fine-tune shot shape, stability, and feel, delivering a tour-inspired blend of control, workability, and trust for attacking distant targets.
The Tech Story
Engineered for consistent long-range performance and precise ball striking, the Titleist GTS3 Fairway Wood features a wraparound composite crown that extends around the head to unlock weight savings and improve overall mass distribution while delivering a clean, confidence-inspiring look at address. A deeper face profile is designed to promote more consistent center-face contact, particularly for players with a downward attack angle, enhancing both control and forgiveness. The lower, deeper center of gravity aligns more closely with the typical point of impact, producing faster ball speeds, higher launch, and reduced spin while maintaining exceptional stability across the face. A Dual Weighting System with interchangeable weights allows for precise CG tuning to match individual swing dynamics, optimizing launch, feel, and shot control. Finished with a tour-preferred face polish, the design improves durability while visually enlarging the hitting area to inspire confidence and promote more consistent ball striking.
Facts and Figures
Desired Ball Flight: Low Spin / Fade Bias
Launch: High
Spin: Low
Adjustability: Titleist SureFit Hosel
Stock Shafts and Grips

Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who value maximum playability and ease of use from the fairway, the Titleist GTS2 Fairway Wood is ideal for players seeking a confidence-inspiring profile that promotes consistent results from a variety of lies. The larger head shape and shallower face work together to make launching the ball easier, especially for those who struggle to elevate fairway woods, while the low center of gravity helps produce a high flight with efficient, low-spin distance. It’s a strong fit for golfers looking for a forgiving, user-friendly option that delivers reliable performance and added confidence on every strike.
The Tech Story
Engineered for maximum playability and consistent launch, the Titleist GTS2 Fairway Wood features a wraparound composite crown that extends around the perimeter of the head to unlock weight savings and enhance overall mass distribution while presenting a clean, confidence-inspiring look at address. A shallower face design increases forgiveness by helping low-face strikes perform more like centered contact, making it easier to achieve consistent results across varying strike locations. The lower, deeper center of gravity is strategically positioned to align more closely with typical impact points, generating faster ball speeds, higher launch, and reduced spin while maintaining exceptional stability throughout the face. A Dual Weighting System with interchangeable weights allows precise tuning of head weight and CG placement to match individual swing dynamics for optimized performance. Completing the design, a tour-inspired face polish enhances durability while making the face appear larger and more forgiving, promoting greater confidence and more consistent ball striking.

Spin: Mid

products.name: Titleist GTS4 Driver
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who generate excess spin and lose distance as a result, the Titleist GTS4 Driver is ideal for players seeking a more penetrating ball flight with added control off the tee. It’s especially suited for those who want to maintain low-spin performance while benefiting from increased forgiveness, thanks to a larger, more stable head design. With enhanced adjustability to fine-tune launch and shot shape, it appeals to golfers looking to optimize both distance and accuracy through precise, customizable performance.
The Tech Story
Engineered for precision control and high-speed performance, the Titleist GTS4 Driver utilizes a Split Mass Frame built on a full thermoform body to strategically reposition weight—driving mass rearward to increase MOI for added stability while shifting it forward to optimize ball speed and launch conditions. The Speed Sync Face features reinforced structural elements that expand the effective hitting area, maintaining consistent ball speeds even on off-center strikes for more reliable distance. Advanced tuning is achieved through expanded SureFit adjustability, where the integration of a CG Track, Dual Weighting System, and SureFit Hosel provides unparalleled control over launch, spin, stability, and shot shape. A larger 460cc head design enhances forgiveness while maintaining a forward center of gravity to preserve low-spin performance, and the Tour-inspired shaping delivers a confidence-inspiring look designed to promote longer, more penetrating drives.
Facts and Figures
Desired Ball Flight: Low Spin / Fade Bias
Launch: High
Spin: Low
Adjustability: Titleist SureFit Hosel

products.name: Aretera AO2 Gray Driver Shaft
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Engineered for golfers who want a powerful yet controlled driver setup, the Aretera AO2 Gray Driver Shaft is ideal for players seeking added stability, consistent shot repeatability, and a more penetrating launch and spin profile. Its design—active in the handle with a firm mid‑to‑tip section and a tip that’s 7% stiffer than the Blue profile—makes it especially well‑suited for golfers who generate higher speeds or need extra tip stability to manage spin. With the combination of Coreless Design and PowerGrid™ enhancing energy transfer and feel, it’s built for those who want to swing efficiently while trusting the shaft to deliver reliable, controlled performance at impact.
The Tech Story
Built from ultra‑high‑modulus exotic fibers and engineered with advanced multi‑directional PowerGrid™ spread‑tow fabric, the Aretera AO2 Gray Driver Shaft integrates lightweight strength with exceptional stress‑dampening properties to enhance stability and feel throughout the swing. This material is woven into an ultra‑thin, interlocking structure that distributes load evenly, improving responsiveness while maintaining precise control. Its Coreless Design removes the traditional bias core and instead embeds bias plies throughout the shaft wall in a complex alternating sequence, creating balanced bending and torsional stiffness from the inside out. With 16–20 segmented plies depending on weight and flex, the AO2 Gray achieves highly efficient energy transfer, superior structural stability, and a uniquely fluid, connected sensation that translates into powerful, repeatable performance at impact.

Launch: Low
Spin: Low
Butt Section: Active
Mid Section: Firm
Tip Section: Ultra-Firm

products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who want to elevate every part of their game, the Garmin Approach G82 Launch Monitor is ideal for players who value accurate swing data, detailed course insights, and feedback they can use anywhere they practice or play. With its integrated launch monitor, putting stroke metrics, high‑resolution touchscreen, and access to more than 43,000 preloaded courses — plus enhanced aerial imagery and long battery life — it fits golfers who want a portable, all‑in‑one tool to improve both on the range and out on the course.
The Tech Story
The Approach G82 combines an integrated launch monitor with advanced GPS technology to create a comprehensive game‑improvement tool for practice and play. Its built‑in radar captures ball speed, club speed, smash factor, and tempo, while dedicated putting metrics — including stroke length, tempo, and ball and club speed — help sharpen consistency on the green. Bag mapping allows golfers to dial in distances for every club, and on‑course intelligence is elevated through features such as enhanced PlaysLike Distance, wind speed and direction when paired with the Garmin Golf app, and Virtual Caddie recommendations that factor in elevation, environmental conditions, and personal swing data. With more than 43,000 preloaded full‑color CourseView maps, aerial imagery, Green View with manual pin placement, hazard and distance‑to‑green information, and optional green contour data, the device delivers unmatched situational awareness. Additional capabilities — including automatic shot tracking with CT10 sensors, PinPointer for blind shots, Range Relay with compatible rangefinders, digital scorecard options, Find My Garmin, and multiple mounting solutions — make it equally powerful on the course and at the range. A water‑resistant IPX7 design, included radar stand, and up to 25 hours of GPS battery life ensure reliable performance in any conditions.

Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who want maximum forgiveness and effortless launch, the Tour Edge 2026 Hot Launch Max D Irons are ideal for players who struggle with consistency and benefit from built‑in slice correction. Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers with a straight‑back‑and‑through stroke who want maximum stability and consistency through the putting motion, the Ping Scottsdale TEC Ally Blue Onset CB Putter is ideal for players seeking confidence at address and smoother tempo. Eye‑Q alignment technology helps promote more consistent gaze patterns to simplify aiming, while the onset hosel positions the shaft behind the face for a clear view of the ball and the forgiveness of a mallet with the feel of a blade. Counterbalanced weighting encourages a more repeatable, fluid stroke, and the PEBAX insert provides a softer feel with dependable distance control, making it a strong choice for golfers who value control, rhythm, and forgiveness on the greens.
The Tech Story
Developed through PING’s collaboration with Tour players and advanced research in the PING Putting Lab, the Scottsdale TEC Ally Blue Onset CB Putter combines alignment science, counterbalanced stability, and high‑forgiveness construction to promote a smoother, more repeatable stroke. The onset hosel design positions the shaft near the centerline of the putter head, behind the top rail and in front of the center of gravity, delivering a clean view of the ball while maintaining exceptional head stability. Counterbalanced weighting enhances tempo and flow by reducing excessive hand action, encouraging a more fluid and consistent stroke motion. Eye‑Q alignment technology, inspired by the proven Quiet Eye eye‑tracking technique, uses a distinct dot focal point on the top rail paired with a long alignment line to help golfers stabilize their gaze before and during the stroke, improving aim and visual consistency. A one‑piece PEBAX insert provides a slightly softer yet responsive feel with reliable distance control, while the lightweight aluminum body and dense stainless steel sole plate push mass low and to the perimeter for extreme MOI and optimized CG. Additional discretionary weight made possible by the PEBAX insert cavity further fine‑tunes performance, resulting in a putter that blends forgiveness, feel, and stroke‑enhancing balance for confident putting.

The i540 iron leverages a series of advanced technologies to deliver players‑distance performance, starting with weight savings from its lighter, shallower forged maraging‑steel face and covered cavity, which allow tungsten to be strategically placed low in the sole of the 4–7 irons. Complementing this is new i‑Beam Technology, which adds structural support across the cavity to stiffen key areas for improved sound and a more solid impact sensation. Together, these innovations create an iron that blends speed, height, precision, and premium feel in a true players‑distance profile.

Designed for golfers who want maximum stability, consistency, and control on the greens, the L.A.B. Golf DF3i Counterbalanced Putter is ideal for players who benefit from a counterbalanced design that smooths out the stroke and keeps the face naturally square. It suits those who love the effortless lie‑angle‑balanced performance L.A.B. putters are known for—where the head stays square on its own and maintains forgiveness even on mishits—while offering a slightly firmer feel and quicker roll thanks to its stainless steel insert. Whether a player struggles with face rotation or simply wants a more stable, repeatable motion, this model caters to golfers seeking a reliably square, highly forgiving putting experience.

These variable‑density weights allow exact tuning of swing weight and lie‑angle balance, ensuring the putter naturally stays square throughout the stroke. Borrowing technology from the OZ.1i and OZ.1i HS models, the DF3i integrates a 303 stainless steel insert that produces a firmer, more responsive feel and faster ball speeds, ideal for golfers who love the DF3 shape but want sharper feedback at impact. In the counterbalanced configuration, added grip‑end mass smooths inconsistencies, reduces unwanted hand and wrist movement, and promotes a relaxed, fluid, repeatable stroke. Together, these technologies create a uniquely stable, highly forgiving putter that enhances control while preserving the effortless face‑square performance L.A.B. putters are known for.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who prefer the stability and unique feel of a longer broomstick-style putter, the Odyssey Ai-DUAL Square 2 Square Max 1/2 Ball Broomstick Putter is ideal for players seeking a zero‑torque, square‑to‑square stroke with minimal face rotation. Combined with the forgiveness of the Max mallet shape, it’s built for players who want maximum control, enhanced alignment, and a smooth, repeatable motion in a long‑length putting configuration.

Featuring a complete integration of roll‑enhancing, alignment‑focused, and stroke‑stabilizing technologies, the Odyssey Ai‑DUAL Square 2 Square Max ½ Ball Broomstick Putter is built around an Artificial Intelligence–engineered dual‑layer urethane insert that pairs a soft outer layer with a firmer inner core to deliver exceptional feel, consistent ball speed, and enhanced forward roll across the entire face. The modern center‑shafted design positions the shaft directly beneath the CG plane, creating a natural toe‑up balance that eliminates traditional toe hang and supports a genuine zero‑torque, square‑to‑square stroke by resisting unwanted face rotation. A built‑in 2° forward shaft lean presets the hands into a natural forward‑press position, preventing the unintentional face opening that often occurs when golfers create their own press. Confidence is further elevated by Odyssey’s innovative ½ Ball alignment technology, which precisely frames the ball to improve aim, highlight face angle, and encourage centered impact. Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers of any skill level who want cleaner contact, controlled flight, and precise spin, the Titleist Vokey SM11 Raw Wedge is ideal for players who want equipment that works naturally with their own technique rather than requiring adjustments. Its extensive selection of lofts, bounces, and grinds ensures every golfer can build a setup tailored to their swing and short‑game style. The Tech Story
The Titleist Vokey SM11 Raw Wedge is engineered with a full suite of SM11 technologies designed to deliver maximum precision, versatility, and spin performance, all in the game’s most complete lineup of 27 tour‑proven loft, bounce, and grind combinations. Its design promotes cleaner, more consistent contact—especially between grooves 2–5—by offering grind options tailored to every swing type and turf condition, giving players the confidence to take on any shot. A consistent CG position within each loft produces controlled, repeatable launch angles across all grind options, allowing golfers to choose their preferred sole design without sacrificing flight consistency. The advanced Vokey Spin System integrates three key innovations: a razor‑like angled face texture that increases friction and extends ball contact for dependable greenside spin, shot‑specific groove profiles optimized for the performance needs of low, mid, and high lofts, and deeper Spin Milled grooves—now 5% larger by volume—to improve debris clearance and preserve spin in rough or wet conditions. Durability is elevated through heat‑treated grooves that last twice as long, ensuring sustained sharpness over time. The SM11 Raw lineup also expands versatility with additions like the Low Bounce K (58.06K, 60.06K), the new 44.10F, and reduced‑bounce versions of the popular K Grind (58.12K, 60.12K), giving players even more precision‑tuned options in a raw finish that naturally wears and rusts for maximum feel and feedback.

Designed for golfers with moderate swing speeds who benefit from lightweight, easy‑to‑launch equipment, the Callaway Quantum Max Fast Irons are built to deliver higher ball flight, faster speed, and greater overall distance with minimal effort. Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who benefit from an overall lighter hybrid setup, the Callaway Quantum Max Fast Hybrid is ideal for players who want to swing more easily while generating higher launch, more height, and more consistent contact. Its lightweight construction from head to grip helps increase clubhead speed with less effort, and the high‑MOI, shallow‑face profile makes it especially well‑suited for those seeking an easy‑to‑hit option that delivers confidence, forgiveness, and reliable performance from a variety of lies.
The Tech Story
Engineered to help moderate swing‑speed players generate effortless speed and higher launch, the Callaway Quantum Max Fast Hybrid combines advanced materials with an ultra‑lightweight construction to maximize carry with less effort. Its Speed Wave 2.0 design positions tungsten low and forward to boost ball speed and maintain a strong, consistent launch, while freeing up more face flex to enhance energy transfer—especially on low‑face strikes. The new Step Sole Design minimizes turf interaction for cleaner, more reliable contact, and a reshaped heel increases stability through impact to help keep the face square for improved accuracy. Heel‑toe weighting supports straighter shots with subtle built‑in correction, and the OptiFit4 hosel provides seven loft‑and‑lie adjustments to fine‑tune launch and gapping. With its shallow, easy‑to‑launch profile and ultra‑forgiving, lightweight build, this hybrid is designed to help players achieve higher flight, improved consistency, and maximum distance with minimal effort.

products.name: Callaway Quantum Max Fast Fairway Wood
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who benefit from an overall lighter club setup, the Callaway Quantum Max Fast Fairway Wood is ideal for players who want to swing more easily while generating higher launch and more consistent contact. Its lightweight construction from head to grip helps increase clubhead speed with less effort, while the high‑MOI design and shallow face profile make it easier to get the ball airborne. It’s especially well‑suited for those seeking a user‑friendly fairway wood that promotes confidence, forgiveness, and effortless performance across a wide range of lies.
The Tech Story
Featuring a lightweight, easy‑to‑swing construction built specifically for moderate swing‑speed players, the Callaway Quantum Max Fast Fairway Wood combines advanced materials and intelligent design to make higher launch and effortless speed more attainable. Its Speed Wave 2.0 structure positions up to 40 grams of tungsten low and forward to increase ball speed and promote a consistent, fast launch, while freeing additional face flex that boosts energy transfer—especially on low‑face impacts where fairway woods typically lose efficiency. The new Step Sole Design minimizes turf interaction for cleaner strikes and more reliable center‑face contact, with a reshaped heel adding stability to help the face stay square through impact for improved accuracy. Next‑generation AI‑optimized face technology precisely tunes each section of the face to optimize speed, spin, launch, and dispersion based on real fairway‑wood impact patterns, ensuring dependable performance across a larger hitting area. As Callaway’s lightest and most user‑friendly fairway wood, its ultra‑forgiving, high‑MOI profile promotes easier launch, added stability, and maximum carry with less effort. And for players seeking fine‑tuned ball flight, the OptiFit4 hosel (3W–5W) offers seven adjustable loft and lie combinations to achieve higher trajectories, straighter shots, or a draw‑biased setup.

products.name: TaylorMade Qi Max HL Single Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The TaylorMade Qi Max HL Irons are built for golfers who want to launch it higher, swing it faster, and carry it farther—without working harder. Designed with an ultralight components package and higher lofts, these irons are made to boost clubhead speed and deliver towering, distance‑packed shots for players with moderate swing speeds. If you’re looking for easy height, more spin, and effortless speed to unlock greater carry distance and accuracy, the Qi Max HL Irons are ready to elevate every swing.
The Tech Story
The TaylorMade Qi Max HL Irons are engineered to deliver higher launch, faster clubhead speeds, and maximum forgiveness through a blend of advanced shaping and finely tuned performance technologies. A new internal stability bar combined with strategically placed ECHO® Damping material supports the top line and face—key areas that influence sound and feel—reducing vibrations and creating a premium, satisfying sensation at impact. TaylorMade’s patented face technology helps control face flexibility to minimize unwanted “cut” spin, promoting straighter distance throughout the entire set. Each iron is individually optimized with a face design tailored to produce the ideal launch and spin for consistent, accurate results. The oversized head shape delivers exceptional forgiveness, featuring a taller face height, increased blade length, wider sole, thicker topline, more offset, and an expanded face area to inspire confidence at address. Built under the Higher and Lighter (HL) philosophy, the Qi Max HL Irons incorporate weaker lofts and an ultralight components package—available in ultra‑lightweight graphite—resulting in an overall club mass up to 56 grams lighter than the standard Qi Max. This combination boosts launch, increases spin, and enhances clubhead speed, making it easier for players with moderate swing speeds to maximize carry distance and accuracy.

A new internal stability bar paired with ECHO® Damper material enhances both sound and feel by supporting key impact zones, minimizing unwanted vibrations, and delivering a premium, more responsive sensation through the strike. products.name: TaylorMade Qi4D Max Lite Driver
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for players who want to swing faster with less effort, the TaylorMade Qi4D Max Lite Driver packs the Qi4D family’s lightest head, shaft, and grip into a speed‑boosting package. Its streamlined shape helps generate effortless acceleration, while the distance‑focused face design keeps performance strong across the hitting area. Combined with adjustable tuning, tour‑proven technologies, and premium shaft options, it’s an ideal choice for golfers who want a driver that’s easy to swing yet powerful, stable, and reliably long.
The Tech Story
The TaylorMade Qi4D Max Lite Driver is engineered for effortless speed through a lightweight design that replaces traditional titanium with a precisely machined, aircraft‑grade 7075 aluminum collar—allowing full adjustability in a max‑MOI head without sacrificing performance. Its oversized head shape boosts inertia and stability, delivering maximum forgiveness while maintaining clubhead speed. Distance is enhanced by an improved roll radius for more consistent spin across vertical strike locations and the ultra‑lightweight 60X Carbon Twist Face™, which promotes faster ball speeds and greater consistency than titanium. Customization comes from a single 4g Trajectory Adjustment System weight for swing‑weight tuning and a color‑matched 4° loft sleeve that adjusts loft, lie, and face angle while complementing the aluminum collar’s look. Paired with premium REAX™ shafts powered by Mitsubishi Chemical’s advanced materials, and supported by tour‑proven technologies—such as an upgraded Speed Pocket™ for low‑face speed retention, CAD‑optimized acoustics, and multi‑material construction for strategic mass placement—the Qi4D Max Lite delivers a powerful blend of speed, forgiveness, and stability in an ultra‑light package.
Facts and Figures
Desired Ball Flight: High MOI / Draw Bias
Launch: High
Spin: Mid
Adjustability: +/- 2° Loft, up to +4° Lie
Stock Shafts and Grips
Stock Shaft: TaylorMade REAX MR40 Blue (L, SR, R)

Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who want maximum stability and effortless power, the TaylorMade Qi4D Max Driver delivers standout forgiveness while still producing impressive distance. Its low‑CG design helps generate strong ball speed from more areas of the face, turning mishits into playable shots. Paired with a speed‑enhancing shape, distance‑driven face technology, adjustable tuning options, tour‑proven innovations, and premium shaft selections, it’s a go‑to choice for players who want confidence, consistency, and reliable long‑game performance.
The Tech Story
The TaylorMade Qi4D Max Driver is engineered for unmatched forgiveness and speed through a modern design that replaces traditional titanium with a lightweight, aircraft‑grade 7075 aluminum collar, allowing for full adjustability in a high‑MOI head without sacrificing clubhead speed. Its new oversized profile boosts inertia and stability, helping golfers maintain performance even on off‑center strikes. Distance is driven by an improved roll radius for more consistent spin and the ultra‑light 60X Carbon Twist Face™, which enhances ball speed and forgiveness across vertical impact locations, with optional reflective markers available for precision fitting. Adjustable performance comes from two Trajectory Adjustment System weights (13g and 4g) and a versatile 4° loft sleeve, enabling players to fine‑tune launch, spin, lie, and face angle. Paired with high‑quality REAX™ shafts from Mitsubishi Chemical and tour‑proven technologies—like the enhanced Speed Pocket™, CAD‑optimized acoustics, and multi‑material construction for strategic mass placement—the Qi4D Max delivers a powerful combination of stability, speed, and consistency.

products.name: Cobra 2026 King Single Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers with average to fast swing speeds who deliver a steeper attack angle, the Cobra 2026 King Irons are built for players who want to maximize distance without sacrificing a traditional look at address. Their strong lofts and classic shaping cater to those who generate enough speed to take advantage of a powerful, penetrating ball flight and are seeking irons that help them hit farther while maintaining confidence‑inspiring visuals.
The Tech Story
The 2026 King Irons leverage a suite of advanced technologies to deliver powerful distance, enhanced forgiveness, and exceptional feel for players seeking more consistent performance. Their 3D‑printed internal structure strategically lowers the center of gravity and redistributes weight to promote higher launch, improved stability, and significantly better accuracy — resulting in 9.5% more greens in regulation and 1.4 strokes gained per round compared to last year’s DS‑ADAPT model. A 360 SPEEDSHELL paired with H.O.T. Face Technology boosts ball speed and maintains strong performance across the entire face, helping golfers hit longer and straighter shots even on mishits. To elevate sound and feel, the hollow body is filled with a specially tuned polymer that softens impact without sacrificing responsiveness. Rounding out the design, the new SKID SOLE — featuring increased leading‑edge bounce and a flatter midsole — delivers cleaner, more efficient turf interaction for golfers with both steep and shallow attack angles, ensuring crisper, more reliable contact swing after swing.

Category: Players Distance
Material: 3D Printed 360 SpeedShell with H.O.T. Face Technology

products.description:
Who’s It For?
The XXIO 14 Ladies Irons are designed for women golfers who want a premium, lightweight set that enhances both distance and control. Engineered specifically for a woman’s swing, these irons feature precise tungsten weighting to promote higher launch angles, longer carry, and straighter shots, all while ensuring softer landings with minimal effort. The Tech Story
The XXIO 14 Ladies Irons combine cutting-edge materials and engineering to deliver exceptional speed, forgiveness, and feel for women golfers. At the core is VR-Titanium, a revolutionary alloy infused with silicon that dramatically increases design flexibility, allowing the face and body to flex more for heightened initial ball speed. This innovation enables a thinner toe section, freeing discretionary mass for optimized weighting. Complementing this is Weight Plus, a proprietary counterbalance system that places mass in the butt-end of the shaft for smoother takeaways, better swing positioning, and easier release through impact. Additionally, the Iron-Specific Rebound Frame incorporates an L-groove positioned lower than previous models to amplify face flex and boost ball speeds. Paired with a Lower CG Body design using tungsten and soft stainless steel for adjustability and improved feel, these irons deliver effortless distance, precision, and playability tailored to a woman’s swing.

products.name: Callaway Quantum Mini Driver
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers who want a more forgiving and versatile option off the tee, the Callaway Quantum Mini Driver is ideal for players who struggle with driver consistency or prefer a reliable fairway‑finder alternative. It’s also a great fit for those who like the idea of replacing or complementing a 3‑wood with something easier to launch, offering confidence‑inspiring control in a compact shape. Powered by a groundbreaking Tri‑Force Face that integrates ultra‑thin titanium, poly mesh, and carbon fiber into a single high‑speed striking platform, the Callaway Quantum Mini Driver delivers exceptional ball speed and distance across a wider portion of the face—even on mis‑hits—using a material combination never before applied in driver design. Adjustable front‑to‑back weighting allows players to tailor ball flight—forward for a flatter, more penetrating trajectory or back for added launch and forgiveness. With its compact, confidence‑inspiring shape, this Mini Driver blends tee‑box power with fairway versatility, giving golfers an easy‑to‑hit option that offers both distance and precise control.

products.name: Ping s259 Midnight Wedge
products.description:
Who’s It For?
With its Tour‑preferred look, sound, and feel, the Ping s259 Midnight Wedges are nothing short of elite. Building on the proven, high‑spin performance of the s159 series, the s259 takes control to the next level with refined grinds and expanded loft options that let players attack every lie and every shot with confidence. Its precision‑milled, wheel‑cut grooves—engineered uniquely for each loft—deliver maximized spin whether you’re taking a full swing, clipping a pitch, or finessing a tight‑lie breaker. Designed for golfers who demand sharper precision, aggressive spin, and tour‑level versatility in their short game.
The Tech Story
The Ping s259 Midnight Wedge blends precision‑engineered performance with a sleek, anti‑glare finish, offering golfers a finely tuned scoring tool for every shot around the green. Its wheel‑cut grooves are precision‑milled to loft‑specific dimensions: lower lofts (46°–52°) use wider 20‑degree sidewalls for maximum groove volume and control on full swings, while higher lofts (54°–62°) feature tightly spaced MicroMax grooves and a friction‑enhancing face blast to generate consistent launch and high spin on delicate pitches and finesse shots. The grind options further elevate versatility—an updated E‑grind provides a more traditional look at address while excelling from bunkers and open‑face situations, the T‑grind’s steeper trail edge lets the club sit extremely low for advanced face manipulation, and new 50° and 52° W‑grind offerings support steeper attack‑angle players who need optimized gapping. Each loft is purpose‑built for its role: straighter leading edges and centered CG in lower lofts blend seamlessly with iron sets, mid‑lofts gain distance control from a full‑length bottom groove and higher CG, and high lofts offer visual offset and a smaller hosel for confidence when shaping shots. Constructed from investment‑cast 8620 carbon steel with a larger re‑shaped elastomer insert for enhanced feel, the s259 Midnight Wedge delivers premium spin, versatility, and performance—wrapped in a stylish, confidence‑boosting midnight finish.
Facts and Figures
B Grind: Shallow attack angle and neutral face delivery ,low bounce
W Grind: Steep attack angle with a lot of handle lean. Max forgiveness
H Grind: Steeper attack angle, best in softer conditions
E Grind: Ultimate bunker club, low bounce on square or slightly open face shots
T Grind: Most versatile, ideal for medium to firm turf conditions
S Grind: Fits a wide variety of conditions and techniques. Heel/trail edge relief for versatility

Who’s It For?
The Titleist Scotty Cameron Studio Style Fastback OC Putter is designed for golfers seeking a mid-mallet putter that delivers low-torque performance and an exceptional feel. Its unique Onset Center (OC) shaft position—set back of the leading edge and in line with the center of gravity—is ideal for players who want to minimize torque and achieve a simplified putting stroke that promotes a square-to-the-path delivery. The putter's design, which includes a ring-weighted mid-mallet footprint, high-contrast alignment, and a precise alignment sight line, targets golfers looking for stability, enhanced alignment, and better feedback from a premium construction of stainless steel and aircraft aluminum with a carbon steel face insert.
The Tech Story
The Titleist Scotty Cameron Studio Style Fastback OC Putter incorporates a low-torque design achieved by positioning the shaft onset from the leading edge and aligning it with the putter head's front-to-back Center of Gravity (CG), a feature specifically engineered to minimize torque and provide a square feel for golfers who want to eliminate face rotation. For a traditional feel and feedback, the Fastback OC model features the Studio Carbon Steel (SCS) face insert with chain-link face milling, which softens the sound while retaining crucial feedback for strike location awareness, especially important in its low-torque setup. Further enhancing a natural and neutral address position, the putter features a minimal one degree of shaft lean and also allows for full loft and lie customization without compromising the low-torque performance. Finally, the design promotes connection to the putting stroke through 15-gram heavier head weights (compared to standard models), matched with a custom black shaft designed to complement the weight increase without dulling feel, and is finished with a tapered Matador Mid grip.

The Odyssey Tri-Hot Square 2 Square Jailbird Cruiser Putter is designed for golfers who favor the Tour-validated, classic shaping of the Jailbird but require the added stability of a longer "Cruiser" configuration. It caters to players looking for a highly successful putter that offers enhanced control and an easier path to performance. By leveraging multi-material construction to move the Center of Gravity (CG) far forward, the putter allows the shaft to enter the head on the topline. This revolutionary technology eliminates the need for shaft lean, thereby making the benefits of the "Zero Torque" category accessible to players who prefer a longer, more stable putter setup.

The Odyssey Tri-Hot Square 2 Square Jailbird Cruiser Putter is engineered for "Zero Torque" stability, particularly for players preferring a longer setup. Its foundation is a Multi-Material Construction using Aluminum, Steel, and over 140 grams of tungsten to position more than 80% of the weight below the topline, enabling a radical Forward Center of Gravity (CG). This forward CG allows the hosel spud to be placed on the topline, closer to the face, ensuring a more natural and intuitive setup that eliminates the need for shaft lean. For exceptional performance on the face, the putter features the Ai-DUAL Insert, an AI-designed, dual-layer urethane system that uses a soft outer layer and a firm core to provide consistent ball speed and feel while promoting enhanced forward roll. This forward roll is maximized by the New FRD (Forward Roll Design) Groove, which is deeper and more aggressive with a 19° slope. products.name: Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Black Ti Utility Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Black Ti Utility Iron is designed for skilled golfers who need a forgiving replacement for their traditional long irons, but still demand the control and precision associated with an iron. This club is perfect for players who want to blend the shot-shaping precision and accuracy of an iron with the explosive distance and ball speed typically found in a metalwood, offering a reliable and high-performance option off the tee or from the fairway, in a premium Black Pearl finish.
The Tech Story
The Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Black Ti Utility Iron is engineered for a powerful blend of distance and forgiveness, centered on its multi-material construction. The core technology is the Beta Titanium L-Cup Face, which is fused to a 431-steel body using Combo-Brazing Technology. This brazing process joins the titanium face to the steel body without welding, saving weight, optimizing the Center of Gravity (CG), and enhancing energy transfer for explosive ball speed and consistent power across the entire face. The L-Cup design itself creates a hinge-like effect at impact, boosting face flex. This assembly is built into a Hollow Body Design, which enables maximum perimeter weighting for enhanced stability. The combination of the deep CG from the hollow body and the large perimeter weighting increases the Moment of Inertia (MOI), delivering superior forgiveness and a high launch, all within a sleek, playable iron-like shape.

Category: Game Improvement
Material: 431-Steel Body with Beta Titanium L-Cup Face
Finish: Black Pearl

products.name: Bushnell Wingman HD Speaker
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Bushnell Wingman HD Speaker is designed for golfers who desire a premium, multi-functional device to enhance their on-course experience. It targets those who appreciate both high-quality audio and advanced golf GPS features, leveraging Bluetooth to allow users to play music while also providing audible and visual front, center, and back distances via a 3.5-inch color HD touchscreen. Furthermore, the integrated BITE magnetic mount appeals to players who value convenience and easy access to their technology, essentially catering to golfers who want to embrace their "inner DJ" while simultaneously elevating their game with precise distance information.
The Tech Story
The Bushnell Wingman HD Speaker is a sophisticated golf technology that seamlessly integrates high-fidelity audio with advanced GPS features. Its audio system delivers a premium experience via 2×15 Watt speakers and two passive radiators, utilizing bidirectional speaker placement for immersive 360° sound, complemented by a Dynamic Audio Adjustment feature that intelligently raises and lowers volume based on cart speed. The device is centered around a 3.5-inch color touchscreen that displays key GPS information, including audible and visual front, center, and back distances, GreenView, HoleView, and updated hazards with dynamic icons. Beyond navigation, the technology includes a Shot Distance Calculator, score entry, and a digital scorecard, all housed in a rugged, IP67 fully dustproof and waterproof casing. The functionality is further enhanced by an integrated BITE Magnetic Cart Mount, customizable 1st Tee Intros and sound bites, a dedicated music screen displaying song information, and True Wireless Stereo (TWS) pairing capability for synchronizing up to 100 Wingman HD units, all powered by a battery offering up to 6 hours of use.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Bettinardi Antidote SB2 Long Putter is designed for golfers who favor a mallet-style head but prefer a moderate size to achieve an optimal blend of forgiveness and feel. Specifically, it targets players who utilize a straight-back-straight-through putting stroke, as its face-balanced design works to minimize face rotation. This makes it an ideal choice for golfers who tend to struggle with an arcing path or have inconsistent face rotation, providing a stable platform for a more reliable and consistent roll.
The Tech Story
The Bettinardi Antidote SB2 Long Putter is engineered with Simply Balanced™ Zero-Torque Technology, which precisely positions the Center of Gravity (CoG) at the dead center of the club head. The putter is milled from 303 Stainless Steel and features Bettinardi's exclusive F.I.T. Face™ (Feel Impact Technology) Face Milling, which removes 55% of the face material to deliver an exceptionally soft and responsive feel at impact. Aesthetically, it showcases a striking look with a Diamond Blast finish on the face and center insert, contrasted by a Sapphire Blue body finish. Complementing these technologies, the putter is outfitted with premium components, including a Chrome Tour Grade shaft and a specialized Winn 2-piece round grip.

The Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Lite Fairway Wood is designed for golfers seeking ease of use and maximum speed in a minimal effort package. The club's ultra-lightweight setup is specifically engineered to help these players generate higher clubhead speed, making it easier to get the ball airborne and achieve greater overall distance with less fatigue.

products.name: Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Max Single Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Max Irons are designed for game-improvement golfers whose primary goal is achieving maximum forgiveness and consistent distance across the entire club face. Featuring a clean, confidence-inspiring look, they are intended for players who prioritize ease of use and reliable yardage, especially on shots that miss the sweet spot. This design delivers higher launch, faster ball speeds, and the consistency and accuracy needed to help golfers hit more greens.
The Tech Story
The Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Max Irons are engineered for maximum distance and forgiveness, centering around the proprietary VIBRCOR Technology, a high-grade TPU compound injected into the head to dampen unwanted vibration, enhance feel, amplify ball speed, and increase perimeter weighting for a solid, powerful strike. Boosting this distance is the innovative Pyramid Face Technology, which utilizes over 100 interwoven pyramid shapes with three different 3D thicknesses to maximize ball speed and significantly expand the sweet spot, increasing forgiveness and speed, particularly on heel and toe strikes. The 360° Undercut Design in the one-piece steel body strategically lowers the Center of Gravity (CG) for a higher launch and increased face flex, while the MOI+ Design features an extreme low-rearward CG placement to maximize Moment of Inertia (MOI), ensuring exceptional stability and resistance to twisting on off-center hits. Finally, a Multi-Material Carbon and TPU Badge, incorporating high-elastic VIBRCOR TPU and carbon fiber, further enhances shock dampening and sound, while saving critical weight to optimize the CG position for a more stable, responsive clubhead.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Ti Utility Iron is designed for skilled golfers who need a forgiving replacement for their traditional long irons, but still demand the control and precision associated with an iron. This club is perfect for players who want to blend the shot-shaping precision and accuracy of an iron with the explosive distance and ball speed typically found in a metalwood, offering a reliable, controllable, and high-performance option off the tee or from the fairway.
The Tech Story
The Tour Edge 2026 Exotics Ti Utility Iron is engineered for a powerful blend of distance and forgiveness, centered on its multi-material construction. The core technology is the Beta Titanium L-Cup Face, which is fused to a 431-steel body using Combo-Brazing Technology. This brazing process joins the titanium face to the steel body without welding, saving weight, optimizing the Center of Gravity (CG), and enhancing energy transfer for explosive ball speed and consistent power across the entire face. The L-Cup design itself creates a hinge-like effect at impact, boosting face flex. This assembly is built into a Hollow Body Design, which enables maximum perimeter weighting for enhanced stability. The combination of the deep CG from the hollow body and the large perimeter weighting increases the Moment of Inertia (MOI), delivering superior forgiveness and a high launch, all within a sleek, playable iron-like shape.

The Tech Story
The 2024 Accra Shogun driver shaft series represents a significant leap in golf shaft technology, designed to optimize launch conditions, increase clubhead speed, and promote more consistent center strikes. The line features a constant taper design across three unique profiles, which allows for precise club fitting to optimize a golfer's low point for improved accuracy and ball speed. At the heart of its construction is the new "ACCelaron MX" material, an ultra-lightweight 5K composite from Toray Japan that combines high modulus and high elasticity. This material ensures rapid recovery and minimizes ovaling, which leads to exceptional speed, stability, and feel. Additionally, the shaft incorporates "Tornado Material Stabilization" (TMS), a manufacturing process that evenly distributes the composite material's strength around the shaft's circumference. This technology stabilizes the shaft's performance at all swing speeds, resulting in unparalleled consistency. The Shogun shafts were developed using S3 analytics and advanced composite materials, showcasing a creative design process focused on delivering a high-performance golf shaft.

The Callaway 2025 Apex UW Fairway Wood is designed for serious, avid golfers who are seeking a combination of a fairway wood's power and a hybrid's versatility. Who’s It For?
The Mizuno JPX 925 Hot Metal Black Ion Irons are designed for mid-to-high handicap players who are looking for a high-launching and forgiving iron. These clubs offer an unmatched consistency in distance across the entire face due to a new CORTECH face with a Contour Ellipse and a blend of Nickel Chromoly. The Tech Story
The Mizuno JPX 925 Hot Metal Black Ion Irons are a technological marvel, designed to deliver high-launch, high-speed performance with unmatched consistency, in a modern finish. The core of their innovation is the CORTECH Design, which features a Contour Ellipse Face—a re-engineered, multi-thickness profile that is 30% thinner than previous models, maximizing ball speed retention across a wide impact area. The Chromoly 4140M material provides a strong face with a bendable hosel, allowing for extensive custom fitting. The Seamless Cup Face geometry extends the thinned areas around the entire perimeter, which boosts rebound and ball speed. For the 4 through 7 irons, strategic, low-positioned tungsten weighting creates a higher launch and steeper landing angles, while a Variable Sole Thickness increases the overall face flex. This technology is rounded out by a Balanced Stability Frame that ensures control and forgiveness, along with Harmonic Impact Technology and Acoustic Sound Ribs that together produce an ideal feel and explosive sound.

products.name: Mizuno Pro T-1 Copper Wedge
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Mizuno Pro T-1 Copper Wedge is designed for players of all skill levels who prioritize shot-making versatility and control. It is particularly suited for those who value the soft feel of forged carbon steel and the performance benefits of having multiple sole options. The wedge's advanced forging and meticulous craftsmanship are intended to provide consistent spin and shot versatility, while the Denim Copper finish minimizes glare and distraction at address.
The Tech Story
The Mizuno Pro T-1 Copper Wedge is a masterclass in forged technology, designed to provide exceptional feel and control. It is crafted in Hiroshima, Japan, using Mizuno's signature Grain Flow Forged HD technology, combining 1025 Pure Select Mild Carbon Steel with a Copper Underlay to produce a soft, responsive feel and exceptional feedback. The wedge's compact teardrop shape and straighter leading edge are tour-inspired, promoting clean turf interaction. The T-1 offers a comprehensive range of six distinct sole grinds—S, M, P, C, V, and X—including the new M grind and a P grind with increased bounce, ensuring a perfect fit for any swing type or course condition. Spin consistency is a priority, achieved through Quad Cut + Grooves and Hydroflow Micro Grooves which work together to enhance spin rates and channel away moisture, ensuring reliable performance even in wet conditions. The groove patterns are also optimized to provide consistent spin on stronger lofts and maximum spin on higher lofts, giving players complete control over their short game. The aesthetic Denim Copper finish not only adds an eye-catching look but also serves a functional purpose by minimizing glare at address.
Facts and Figures
Material: 1025 Pure Select Mild Carbon Steel with a Copper Underlay
Finish: Denim Copper

M - Grind: Enhanced relief with moderate effective bounce

Who’s It For?
The Mizuno Pro T-3 Black Ion Wedge is designed for golfers who want a balance of forgiveness and feel in their short game. With its shallow cavity back and a longer head shape, it provides increased stability on off-center hits, making it an ideal choice for players who prioritize consistency without giving up the ability to execute finesse shots. This wedge also delivers consistent spin, shot versatility, and the signature elegance that is characteristic of Mizuno.
The Tech Story
The Mizuno Pro T-3 Black Ion Wedge is engineered to deliver a masterful blend of feel, forgiveness, and versatility. It is Grain Flow Forged HD from 1025 Pure Select Mild Carbon Steel and features a Copper Underlay, which provides the signature soft feel and exceptional feedback that is a hallmark of Mizuno's forged wedges. A new shallow cavity back design increases the head's length, enhancing stability and forgiveness on off-center strikes. The T-3 offers three distinct sole profiles (S, M, and C), which are designed to support a variety of playing styles and shot types, from full swings to delicate touch shots. To ensure consistent performance in any condition, the wedge uses Quad Cut + Grooves and Hydroflow Micro Grooves to boost spin rates and channel away moisture. The groove patterns are also specifically optimized, with stronger lofts focusing on spin consistency and higher lofts engineered for maximum spin and control.

Who’s It For?
The Cleveland CBZ Full Face Wedge is designed for golfers who use modern cavity back or hollow-set irons and are looking for a wedge that offers both forgiveness and versatility. It caters to players who want to blend their wedges seamlessly with their existing clubs while also benefiting from a softer Z-Alloy material for enhanced feel and full-face grooves for maximum spin and control.
The Tech Story
The Cleveland CBZ Full Face Wedge utilizes a suite of technologies designed to enhance feel, forgiveness, and spin performance. The standout feature is the Full-Face design, which extends grooves from hosel to toe, combined with a high-toe profile to provide exceptional versatility for creative, open-face shots around the green. The club is constructed with Z-Alloy, a new steel material that is softer and lighter than traditional materials, offering a superior feel and improved forgiveness. At its core, ZipCore technology utilizes a low-density core to replace heavier material in the hosel and heel, repositioning the Center of Gravity to optimize impact and increase MOI for greater stability. For superior spin, the UltiZip groove pattern features sharper, deeper grooves to cut through debris and maintain consistent spin from various lies, while HydraZip technology employs a specialized face blast and laser-milled lines to maximize friction and spin, particularly in wet conditions, with configurations that are dynamically tailored to each loft.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
L.A.B. Golf OZ.1i HS Custom Putter is a premium, personalizable putter designed for golfers who prefer the traditional aesthetic of a heel-shafted, half-moon mallet but want the modern performance benefits of Lie Angle Balance technology. It is particularly suited for players who value a solid, firmer feel and faster ball speeds, thanks to its solid-body construction and stainless steel insert. With its exceptional forgiveness, the OZ.1i is a great choice for golfers of all skill levels who seek to improve their accuracy and distance control without having to manipulate the putter face during the stroke.
The Tech Story
The L.A.B. Golf OZ.1i HS Custom Putter is the first heel-shafted putter to integrate Lie Angle Balance technology, providing golfers with a traditional aesthetic while eliminating torque for unmatched stability and ease of use. This isn't just a simple modification; the chassis was entirely re-engineered to accommodate a proprietary aluminum riser that connects the shaft to the head, preserving perfect balance and delivering the same forgiveness as L.A.B. Golf's other acclaimed models. The design itself was inspired by a collaboration with tour professional Adam Scott, who sought to combine the elegant lines of a German sports car with a classic mallet shape. This led to the creation of the solid-body OZ.1 for exceptional feel and stability. A stainless steel insert provides a firmer feel and faster ball speeds, while the custom options further tailor performance. Golfers can choose between a traditional 0-degree (Vertical) Shaft Lean for use with a standard grip or a 2-degree Shaft Lean designed specifically for a Press Grip, allowing for a personalized setup that optimizes accuracy and roll.
Facts and Figures
Head Style: Half Moon Mallet
Neck Type: Aluminum Riser Heel Shaft
Toe Hang: Face Balanced
Material: Anodized 6061 Aircraft Aluminum and 303 Stainless Steel
Insert: Medium Fly Mill Stainless Steel

products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Cobra 2025 Baffler Irons are a "super game-improvement" combo set designed for golfers who prioritize maximum forgiveness and easy launch. They are specifically targeted at a wide range of players, including mid- to high-handicappers, seniors, and beginners, who often struggle with consistent contact or generating adequate clubhead speed. The set's unique blend of hybrid-irons, hollow irons, and cavity-back wedges is engineered to make the game less punishing and more enjoyable, providing the confidence and consistency needed to improve and get the ball airborne with less effort from every distance and lie.
The Tech Story
Celebrating 50 years since the original Baffler took the golf industry by storm, the Cobra 2025 Baffler Irons are a testament to five decades of forgiveness-focused innovation. This "super game-improvement" set is the first of its kind to utilize five unique constructions, each meticulously engineered to deliver instant improvement from every distance and every lie. The set begins with Baffler Hybrid-Irons in the 6 and 7-iron, which feature a hollow design that combines hybrid-like forgiveness with the precision of an iron. For the 8 and 9-irons, the Baffler Hollow Irons feature a more traditional iron shape while still providing a blend of speed and control. The set then moves to the Baffler Cavity Back Irons for the pitching wedge (PW), offering maximum accuracy on shorter approach shots. Lastly, the Baffler Cavity Back Wedges (available separately) take Cobra's signature cavity-back design to the sand wedge (SW) for ultimate forgiveness and versatility around the green. All of this is underpinned by the re-engineered Progressive Baffler Rail Tech, which features varying rail heights throughout the set to provide optimal turf interaction, ensuring the clubs glide effortlessly through any lie for consistent, high-quality contact.

products.name: Cleveland CBZ Wedge
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Cleveland CBZ Wedge is designed for golfers who use modern cavity back or hollow sets and are looking for a highly forgiving and versatile wedge. The use of the new, softer Z-Alloy Wedge material makes it ideal for players who value a premium feel and want to take advantage of Cleveland Golf's latest tour-caliber technologies for enhanced performance.
The Tech Story
The Cleveland CBZ Wedge incorporates several advanced technologies to optimize performance. At its core, the proprietary ZipCore technology replaces heavy material in the heel and hosel with a lightweight core, which repositions the Center of Gravity to be closer to the point of impact and increases the Moment of Inertia (MOI) for enhanced forgiveness. The clubface features HydraZip, a system of face blasts and laser-milled lines that are dynamically configured by loft to maximize and balance spin, particularly in wet conditions. This is complemented by UltiZip grooves, which are sharper and deeper to cut through grass and debris and maintain consistent spin from various lies. The new Z-Alloy material, a softer, lighter, and durable steel, is utilized to provide a superior feel, better forgiveness, and improved consistency. Additionally, a Full-Face option is available, which extends grooves from the hosel to the toe and utilizes a high-toe profile, offering expanded versatility for executing creative, open-face shots around the green.

products.name: Callaway Opus SP Black Shadow Wedge
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Callaway Opus SP Black Shadow Wedge is designed for skilled players who want to achieve greater control and precision in their short game. This wedge is purpose-built for those who demand the ability to flight the ball lower and increase spin, particularly from scoring distances, which allows for more predictable and accurate shots around the green. With its advanced construction, refined face groove technology, and Tour-preferred shaping, it serves as an ultimate scoring tool for competitive golfers looking to maximize their performance.
The Tech Story
The Callaway Opus SP Black Shadow Wedge features a suite of advanced technologies designed for precision and control. Its Spin Pocket Construction is a re-engineered two-piece head that repositions weight high in the clubhead. This raises the center of gravity (CG), which in turn promotes a lower, more penetrating ball flight for increased spin and control, especially when attacking pins. The club's face incorporates the New Spin Gen2.0 Face, featuring a new 17° groove angle with tighter spacing for more consistent groove contact. This, combined with a deeper cross-hatch laser pattern, generates enhanced friction for maximum bite and stopping power on all types of approach shots. Lastly, the Tour Validated profile is a refined clubhead shape, the final and sixth iteration of the Opus prototype, which was trusted and approved by Tour players. Its progressive shaping in the gap wedges ensures a seamless transition and a cohesive look when paired with modern iron sets.
Facts and Figures
Steel Swingweight: D3 - D5
Graphite Swingweight: C9 - D1
*Swingweights based on stock build, may vary based on customization*
Grind Options
T Grind: Designed for players who keep the leading edge low, with ultra shallow divots
C Grind: Ideal for players needing versatility in shot making, with shallow divots
X Grind: Designed for shotmakers who want added bounce for forgiveness, without giving up versatility
S Grind: Fits a variety of swingtypes, best for those who prefer square face shots with moderate divots
W Grind: The widest sole offering, for deep divot players who may benefit with more forgiveness
