Who’s It For?
The Cobra KING TEC Mini Driver is built for golfers who crave power with precision. Its compact, confidence‑inspiring shape gives players of all skill levels a dynamic option off the tee—one that delivers explosive distance while tightening dispersion far better than a traditional 460cc driver. Whether you're adding a strategic second driver or swapping out your current big stick, the TEC Mini offers a potent blend of forgiveness, control, and versatility in a sleek, go‑anywhere package.
The Tech Story
The Cobra KING TEC Mini Driver packs a full suite of advanced technologies into its compact 303cc head, offering golfers a highly controllable yet powerful option off the tee or from the fairway. Its smaller footprint is easier to square at impact, while the shorter 43.75" configuration—compatible with any FutureFit33 3‑wood shaft—promotes exceptional control and consistent center contact. A low, back CG created through internal weighting and interchangeable 12g and 2g external weights delivers high launch and added carry without excess spin, allowing players to fine‑tune performance by adjusting weight placement. The multi‑material construction, featuring a titanium body, carbon crown, and PWRSHELL H.O.T. Face, maximizes stability and forgiveness across the entire face for straighter shots and tighter dispersion. Rounding out the design, the FutureFit33 adjustable hosel provides 33 loft and lie combinations with +/- 2° of movement and maintains a square face through SMARTPAD® technology, giving golfers unmatched ability to dial in their ideal ball flight.

Desired Ball Flight: Neutral

products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Evnroll Z5 Hatchback CS Putter is designed for golfers who prefer a center-shafted putter and desire the advanced performance of Evnroll's ZERO "Torque" technology. It caters to players seeking perfect balance and alignment, exceptional distance control, and tight dispersion, all facilitated by its patented SweetFace Technology. Furthermore, its innovative and adjustable pin hosel makes it an ideal choice for golfers who value the ability to customize their putter's loft and lie.
The Tech Story
The Evnroll Z5 Hatchback CS Putter features a sophisticated blend of technologies for enhanced putting precision. Its "Zero Torque Balanced" design is central, where the shaft precisely enters the clubhead at its center-of-gravity, effectively eliminating torque during the putting stroke. This innovative setup, combined with an adjustable pin hosel for easy loft and lie customization, ensures a conventional, vertical shaft at address with zero shaft lean, allowing the putter face to remain square to the target throughout the entire stroke. This design also provides an unobstructed view of the putter face behind the ball, virtually eliminating face rotation and the tendency to pull putts. "Optimized Weighting" is achieved through 100% milled tungsten and steel weights, strategically placing up to half of the clubhead's total weight in the extreme heel and toe—a significantly higher proportion than other zero-torque putters—with these weights meticulously adjusted to maintain a consistent swing weight across all available putter lengths. Finally, Evnroll's patented "SweetFace Technology™" guarantees consistent ball speeds on both center and off-center hits, ensuring even distance and virtually zero dispersion by accurately redirecting the ball towards the target line.

Who’s It For?
The TaylorMade Milled Grind 5 Charcoal Wedge is designed for golfers of all skill levels who want to enhance both their full swing and short game performance. By incorporating proven TaylorMade technologies, these wedges aim to provide a versatile solution for any golfer looking to improve their scoring from a variety of lies and distances around the green.
The Tech Story
The TaylorMade Milled Grind 5 Charcoal Wedge is a technologically advanced club engineered for exceptional feel, spin, and consistency. Forged from soft carbon steel, its geometry is specifically designed to provide a soft, responsive feel and excellent feedback. The wedge features all-new, aggressive saw-milled grooves with tighter tolerances, steeper walls, and sharper radii, which are intended to maximize spin in both dry and wet conditions. This spin performance is further enhanced by a RAW face with Spin Tread technology, which uses laser-etched channels to redirect water at impact, much like a car tire's tread, to maintain friction and spin in wet weather. A charcoal finish also minimizes glare and adds to the aesthetic appeal. Finally, the wedge's craftsmanship is a testament to precision, with each sole grind being hand-polished and then precision-milled to eliminate human error, ensuring consistent performance and quality on every shot.
Facts and Figures
Swingweight: D3 - D5 (Based on stock specs, swingweight may vary based on customization)
Grind Options
LB Grind: Designed for players who want the leading edge to sit low to the ground in a variety of face positions. Intended for shallow swing styles and tight, firm conditions.
SC Grind: Built for the golfer who plays in all types of conditions and demands ultimate greenside versatility. Also provides consistent stability on full shots with heel and toe relief when manipulating the face.

products.name: TPT Golf Nitro Range Driver Shaft
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The TPT Golf Nitro Range Driver Shaft is designed for golfers who demand ultimate distance and precision. Engineered with an exceptional torque-to-weight ratio, Nitro combines refined shaft geometry and optimized fiber placement through advanced Final Element Analysis and TPT’s automated spine-free process. Its lightweight, low-torque design delivers explosive distance while maintaining tighter dispersion, making it ideal for players seeking maximum power without sacrificing control or consistency.
The Tech Story
The TPT Golf Nitro Range Driver Shaft is built on Thin Ply Technology (TPT), an advanced process that uses ultra-thin graphite fiber plies—twice as thin as traditional graphite—to create a more uniform and precise structure, much like sharpening an image’s resolution. Originally developed for high-performance industries such as aerospace, motorsport, and elite sail racing, this technology delivers immediate feedback and enhanced club head awareness, allowing golfers to swing with confidence while the shaft maintains consistent strike locations. TPT’s breakthrough lies in its automated, spine-free design, achieved by perfectly aligning fibers along the shaft’s axis during winding on a conical mandrel, eliminating parasitic bending and ensuring 0° fiber deviation. This innovation, combined with a low-torque profile, provides unmatched stability and consistency, enabling players to use softer shafts for improved control and distance. The Nitro Range offers models from 14 to 21, spanning the stiffest and heaviest to the softest and lightest options, and comes in Hi or Lo series to match individual launch preferences.

products.name: Callaway Apex Ti Fusion 250 Plated Single Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Callaway Apex Ti Fusion 250 Plated Irons are designed for the discerning golfer who is tired of compromising between the punishing feel of a traditional blade and the bulky appearance of a game-improvement iron. These irons serve as the ideal "middle ground" for players seeking a high-launching, consistently spinning club that offers an exceptional feel and a premium, timeless aesthetic. They are built for those who value both performance and refined design, providing a blend of distance, forgiveness, and shot-making ability without sacrificing feel or visual appeal.
The Tech Story
The Callaway Apex Ti Fusion 250 Plated Irons integrate a suite of advanced technologies to deliver a sophisticated blend of performance and feel. Key to its design is the titanium AI Smart Face, which ensures incredibly consistent ball speed, spin, dispersion, and forgiveness, emulating the consistency of a muscleback iron with the added benefits of a two-piece construction and enhanced forgiveness. This is paired with an unimaginable feel, achieved through the titanium face's deflection and interaction with patented urethane microspheres, all housed within a forged steel body, a combination typically found only in single-piece forged irons but now available in a larger, more confidence-inspiring distance iron. The use of superior materials is paramount, with an industry-leading brazed titanium construction that harnesses the power of a titanium face alongside the exceptional feel of forged steel. A groundbreaking all-new chrome-plated finish, a proprietary Callaway process, allows for chrome plating on titanium, creating a bold, timeless aesthetic that sets a new standard in premium design. Finally, the Apex Ti Fusion 250 is built for confidence and forgiveness, featuring a larger footprint, thicker topline, added offset, and extended blade length compared to its predecessor, providing a more confidence-inspiring look at address and greater forgiveness on off-center strikes.

Category: Game Improvement
Stock Set Makeup: 5 - PW, AW

products.name: Garmin Venu X1 GPS Watch
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Garmin Venu X1 GPS Watch is designed for individuals who desire a premium, stylish smartwatch with a large, bright AMOLED display, while also demanding robust, high-end fitness tracking and navigation features typically found in Garmin's more performance-oriented Forerunner and Fenix series. It aims to bridge the gap between mainstream smartwatches like the Apple Watch Ultra and Garmin's dedicated sports watches, appealing to users who want a sleek, thin design for daily wear but also require advanced metrics, onboard maps, and excellent GPS for serious athletic pursuits.
The Tech Story
The Garmin Venu X1 GPS Watch is a sophisticated wearable that seamlessly integrates practical smartwatch functionalities with a comprehensive suite of advanced health, fitness, and navigation tools, all housed within a lightweight and premium design. Its centerpiece is a large, vibrant 2-inch AMOLED display, protected by a scratch-resistant sapphire lens, ensuring excellent readability of data. The watch boasts a sleek profile with a titanium caseback and ComfortFit nylon band, prioritizing all-day wearability. For health and wellness, the Venu X1 offers 24/7 monitoring, including HRV status, advanced sleep tracking, Body Battery energy monitoring, and Pulse Ox, providing users with a detailed "morning report" for a holistic overview of their physiological state. Fitness enthusiasts will benefit from over 100 preloaded sports apps and Garmin Coach plans, while advanced performance metrics like training readiness, endurance score, training status, and hill score offer valuable insights into training adaptation and recovery needs. Beyond fitness, the Venu X1 provides everyday utility with a built-in LED flashlight, on-wrist calling and voice command capabilities (when paired with a smartphone), and sophisticated navigation features, including preloaded TopoActive maps and CourseView maps for over 43,000 golf courses worldwide, making it an ideal companion for both rigorous training and outdoor exploration.

products.name: Titleist 2025 U505 Utility Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Titleist 2025 U505 Utility Iron is designed for golfers, including many of the game's best ball-strikers on the PGA TOUR, who seek a highly versatile, high-launching alternative to traditional long irons. It's ideal for players looking for increased speed and consistency at the top of their bag, preferring an iron-like feel and control with the added benefit of a larger footprint and slightly higher launch than other utility iron models. The progressive shaping from stronger to weaker lofts also caters to players who value precise control and a seamless transition within their set.
The Tech Story
The Titleist 2025 U505 Utility Iron integrates a high-strength, hollow-body steel construction, providing a sleek aesthetic while housing advanced performance technology. This design incorporates progressive shaping, where the sole width gradually narrows and face height progressively increases from the stronger to weaker lofts, optimizing playability across the available 1-iron through 4-iron models. These utilities leverage forged L-Face constructions, lower CG positions, and V-Taper designs to significantly enhance ball speed and elevate launch, particularly on off-center and low-face impacts, ensuring consistent distance and optimal peak heights. Further bolstering performance, improved Max Impact technology works to deliver more uniform speed, distance, launch, and spin rates. The U505's higher-launching profile is further aided by split high-density tungsten weighting, strategically positioned to raise launch angles and dramatically increase forgiveness.

products.name: Titleist 2025 T250U Utility Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Titleist 2025 T250U Utility Iron is designed for a wide range of golfers, from elite PGA TOUR professionals to competitive amateurs, who seek a compact, high-performance long iron replacement. As the more compact utility option compared to the U•505, it offers the same construction, shaping, and loft progression as the T250 irons, providing a seamless transition for players who prioritize an iron-like feel and appearance. Ideal for those who value precise control, speed, and consistency, the T250U, available in 2-, 3-, and 4-iron models, delivers a blend of distance and workability that has made Titleist the most played utility iron on Tour.
The Tech Story
The Titleist 2025 T250U Utility Iron is engineered with a singular, high-performance design, utilizing a high-strength, hollow-body steel construction that offers a clean, traditional iron aesthetic while discreetly housing advanced technology. This utility iron maintains the exact profile of the standard T250 2-, 3-, and 4-irons, ensuring a seamless visual and feel transition within a player's set. To achieve elevated ball speed, the T250U benefits from forged L-Face constructions, strategically lowered center of gravity (CG) positions, and V-Taper designs, all working in concert to improve ball speed and elevate launch, even on off-center and low-face strikes, thereby promoting consistent distance and optimal peak heights. Furthermore, enhanced consistency across the face is ensured by improved Max Impact technology, which delivers more uniform speed, distance, launch, and spin rates throughout the clubface.
Facts and Figures
Head Type: Forged
Material: Forged hollow-body construction
Finish: Chrome
Shaft and Grip Info
Stock Shaft: Project X HZRDUS Black 5G 80g, 90g
Stock Grip: Titleist Universal 360 Std.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Callaway 2025 X Forged Max Irons are designed for better players, particularly those with low-to-mid handicaps, who desire the pure feel and precision of a forged iron but also appreciate a slight increase in forgiveness. They cater to golfers who want a mid-compact profile that offers a blend of workability and feedback without sacrificing a touch of added confidence, making them a great option for those looking to improve consistency while maintaining a player's aesthetic.
The Tech Story
The Callaway 2025 X Forged Max Irons are engineered for forged precision and pure feel, constructed from a single piece of 1020 Carbon steel to deliver the soft feel and crisp sound preferred by better players. These irons feature a mid-compact profile that optimally blends workability and feedback with a touch of forgiveness. Their clean, mid-compact shape includes a more player-friendly cavity back and offset, along with a refined topline, appealing to better players seeking a balance of workability and added forgiveness. Further enhancing performance, the tri-level sole design with beveled leading and trailing edges ensures smooth turf interaction and precise ball control through impact.

Who’s It For?
Designed for golfers seeking a blend of high launch, exceptional distance, and stability, The Titleist GT1 3Tour Fairway Wood is perfect for those who benefit from a "Tour Loft" to manage spin. Its design, featuring a shallow face and low center of gravity, targets players looking to elevate their launch without over-spinning the ball. The adjustable fore/aft weights further customize ball speed, launch, and spin, making it ideal for golfers who desire precise control and confidence from the fairway.
The Tech Story
The Titleist GT1 3Tour Fairway Wood incorporates several advanced technologies to optimize performance. A key innovation is the "Tour Loft" design, which features a stronger loft compared to the standard GT1 Fairway. This adjustment is specifically engineered to maintain optimal spin while still delivering high launch and impressive distance, a critical factor for skilled players. The club also boasts a Seamless Thermoform Crown, an ultra-lightweight design that, in conjunction with a refined player profile and shallow face, significantly lowers the center of gravity (CG) within the clubhead. This lower CG enhances stability and promotes higher launch angles, contributing to consistent and playable results. Further customization and performance tuning are provided by the Dual Performance Control Settings, which utilize adjustable fore/aft weights. Golfers can position the heavier weight towards the back for increased stability and launch, or forward for greater ball speed and reduced spin, allowing for personalized optimization. Finally, a meticulously Redesigned Internal Hosel contributes to overall performance by achieving subtle mass improvements, demonstrating Titleist's commitment to maximizing every gram of weight savings for tangible on-course benefits.

products.name: Ping iDi Utility Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Ping iDi Utility Iron is engineered for better golfers who desire enhanced driving and long-iron performance. With three optimized loft choices (2, 3, and 4 irons), it allows players to precisely dial in their distance and trajectory. The thinner, forged maraging steel face is designed to flex more, resulting in increased ball speed and distance. Furthermore, the iDi improves turf interaction through its strategic design, featuring more bounce, a rounded lead edge, and increased sole camber, making it a versatile option for skilled players seeking a reliable alternative to traditional long irons or hybrids.
The Tech Story
The Ping iDi Utility Iron is a meticulously engineered club, offering distinct performance profiles across its three standard lofts: the 2-iron delivers low launch and spin as a traditional driving iron, the 3-iron provides mid launch and spin for versatile use as a driving or long-iron replacement, and the 4-iron boasts higher launch and more spin, making it ideal for holding greens. Its 17-4 stainless steel head, deeper front-to-back yet shallower, achieves a 15% higher MOI on high/low impacts, significantly enhancing forgiveness. This design also creates space for the innovative inR-Air technology, a small pocket of air within the clubhead that effectively damps sound and refines feel. Further contributing to a superior feel, a covered cavity and i-Beam structure actively reduce unwanted vibrations, while an aesthetically pleasing, chrome-plated ABS badge further enhances sound and feel. The iDi's compact heel-to-toe dimension and reduced offset make it easier to "turn over" for shot shaping. For precision control, each iDi is approximately 1/4" shorter and 1° flatter than standard, and the fixed hosel accommodates all 10 PING Color Codes for lie angle customization. Power and Retro spec lofts are also available alongside the standard 17°, 20°, and 23° options, providing extensive fitting versatility. Complementing these design elements, a thinner, forged C300 maraging steel face flexes optimally to increase ball speed and distance, and improved turf interaction is ensured by added bounce, a rounded lead edge, and increased sole camber.

The Bettinardi Oil Rubbed Bronze PVD MB24 Irons are designed for discerning golfers who prioritize both classic feel and modern performance, all within a visually striking package. These limited-edition irons cater to players seeking maximum control and added forgiveness from a player's profile, characterized by a thinner topline and differential muscle back weighting. The Bettinardi Oil Rubbed Bronze PVD MB24 Irons feature a sophisticated blend of technologies engineered to provide exceptional feel, precise control, and enhanced forgiveness for the discerning golfer. This innovative material combination creates optimized weight profiles that maximize forgiveness while maintaining balance and consistency across the set. Additionally, Progressive COG Positioning ensures loft-dependent placement of the tungsten and CMC components, precisely positioning the center of gravity in each iron. This progressive shift generates higher launch in long irons, controlled backspin in scoring irons, and tighter dispersion with consistent gapping throughout the set. Finally, the Classic Shape Designed to Perform features a timeless head shape that inspires confidence at address, complemented by a meticulously shaped sole to optimize bounce, ensuring prime turf interaction for effective energy transfer from club to ball.

products.name: TaylorMade Spider 5K-ZT Long Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Zero-torque putters are the hottest thing in golf right now, and the Spider 5K-ZT Long Putter is one of TaylorMades new premium offerings. Specifically designed for golfers who prefer the added stability and control offered by a longer putter, Its low torque shaft design and high MOI construction incorporated into the longer design can help minimize wrist movement and create a more pendulum-like stroke, making it particularly suitable for players seeking increased stability and a consistent putting motion. The unique sole shaping accommodates various putting styles and ball positions, while the milled True Path™ alignment aids those who value clear visual cues for accurate setup.
The Tech Story
The TaylorMade Spider 5K-ZT Long Putter is engineered for exceptional stability and precise alignment, featuring a low torque design achieved through a KBS putter shaft bored directly toe-ward near the CG with a 1° shaft lean and 25mm onset. Its uniquely shaped sole is specifically crafted to complement this hosel configuration, accommodating various player types and ball positions to promote a consistent and repeatable stroke. The putter's stability is further enhanced by a construction that combines high-density stainless steel and low-density aerospace-grade aluminum, resulting in a high MOI design that allows the shaft to sit closer to the face. For improved accuracy, the milled True Path™ alignment system incorporates tour-inspired lines the width of a golf ball, assisting golfers in properly indexing to the center of the face. Finally, the black Pure Roll™ insert, made from Surlyn and aluminum with 45° angled grooves, encourages optimal forward roll while providing enhanced sound, feel, and overall roll characteristics.

products.name: Cobra 3DP Tour Single Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Utilizing 3D printing technology to unlock a new realm of performance, the Cobra 3D Printed Tour Irons feature a one of a kind design which results in the most forgiving blade shape on the market. With 3D Printed steel construction and a players blade shape, the 3DP Tour Irons deliver the forgiveness that aspirational players need, and the sleek looks and soft feel that better players desire.
The Tech Story
The Cobra 3DP Tour Irons represent a revolutionary advancement in golf club design, leveraging 3D printing technology to create a high-performance player's iron. Each iron is meticulously 3D printed from 316 stainless steel, a process that unlocks design freedom unattainable with traditional forging or casting methods. This innovative manufacturing allows for the creation of a compact blade shape reminiscent of the KING TOUR iron, but with the forgiving mass properties of a game improvement iron. Internally, a complex lattice structure reduces the club's weight by 33%, allowing up to 100g of tungsten to be strategically placed low in the heel and toe. This precise weighting scheme results in a high Moment of Inertia (MOI) for enhanced forgiveness and a low Center of Gravity (CG) for optimal launch conditions, all while maintaining the soft feel and pleasing acoustics demanded by better players. The internal lattice also provides the necessary strength and stiffness to support the face, further contributing to the exceptional feel and performance of the 3DP Tour Irons.

Finish: Satin Chrome

Who’s It For?
Evnroll has consistently pushed the boundaries of versatility since the 2022 launch of the original V-Series, offering customizable components for a range of putter configurations. Building on this legacy, Evnroll has introduced the next evolution in the V-Series for 2025: the Evnroll 38 Tour Spec V5.2 Putter. This refined winged mallet features straight cavity sightlines, a 100% milled 303 stainless steel face, a milled 6061 aluminum body, and Tungsten and steel weights for a high MOI.
The Tech Story
The Evnroll 38 Tour Spec V5.2 Putter utilizes SweetFace™ Technology to revolutionize putting performance. This technology features closely spaced, variable-width channels on the putter face that minimize ball dispersion, consistently redirecting the ball down the target line for unparalleled accuracy. These v-shaped channels also ensure even roll distance by transferring energy evenly across the face, so both center and off-center hits travel the same distance. Extensive robot testing has validated the superior performance of SweetFace™ compared to standard milled faces. Combining traditional blade aesthetics with modern technology, the putter features a stainless steel face and front section for classic feel, while the rear aluminum chassis and four strategically placed tungsten weights provide the high MOI benefits of a mallet for enhanced stability and forgiveness. Additionally, six adjustable weight ports allow for precision swing weighting, dynamic toe flow adjustments, and perimeter weighting to further optimize performance.

Neck Type: Short Plumbers Neck
Material: 303 Stainless steel & 6061 aluminum rear
Toe Hang: 25°
Headweight: 380g
Alignment: Single Top Line and Dual Back Cavity Lines

products.name: Evnroll Carlsbad M1 Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Evnroll Carlsbad M1 Putter is designed for golfers who appreciate the classic look and feel of a mallet putter but desire the performance benefits of modern technology. Players seeking enhanced forgiveness and consistent roll, even on off-center hits, will find the M1 appealing.
The Tech Story
The Evnroll Carlsbad M1 Putter seamlessly blends classic design with cutting-edge technology to enhance putting performance. This heel-toe weighted blade putter features a mid-length plumber neck hosel and a slightly larger footprint for added stability and forgiveness. At the heart of the M1's performance is Evnroll's SweetFace™ Technology. This innovative design employs a series of closely spaced, variable-width channels on the putter face. Wider in the center and gradually narrowing towards the heel and toe, these channels create a precisely calibrated v-shape that progressively redirects the ball down the target line, minimizing ball dispersion and ensuring exceptional accuracy. This variable channel width also ensures even roll distance. As the channels narrow away from the center, the spacing increases, leading to a larger contact surface and greater energy transfer on off-center hits. Rigorous robot testing has validated the superior performance of SweetFace™ compared to standard milled putter faces. The Carlsbad M1 is finished with a sleek black coating and contrasting alignment features for enhanced visual clarity at address.
Facts and Figures
Head Type: Mallet
Neck Type: Short Slant
Material: 303 Stainless steel with a Black finish
Toe Hang: 27°
Alignment: Single Back Cavity Line
Headcover: Evnroll Carlsbad Series Black
Shaft and Grip Info

products.name: Titleist Scotty Cameron 2025 Studio Style Catalina Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Scotty Cameron is proud to introduce the 2025 Studio Style line, a revolutionary re-design of his iconic blade putter offering. This collection represents a bold step forward, blending Scotty's renowned craftsmanship and design with innovative materials, milling techniques, and advanced technology. The Titleist Scotty Cameron 2025 Studio Style Catalina putter is designed for players who appreciate the classic aesthetics of a slightly wider blade putter but desire the enhanced stability and feel typically associated with modern, mid-bend shafted mallets.
The Tech Story
The Titleist Scotty Cameron 2025 Studio Style Catalina putter revives a classic name with modern technology and design. Milled from 303 stainless steel, this wider-bodied blade putter shares its width with the Newport Plus but features a clean sole design without a sole plate. Its innovative Studio Carbon Steel (SCS) face insert, featuring an electroless nickel plating for durability, provides a soft feel and sound reminiscent of traditional carbon steel. The Catalina also incorporates a new chain-link face milling pattern for enhanced roll performance and customizable stainless steel sole weights for personalized balance. A single, mid-bend shaft promotes a near-face balanced performance, minimizing face rotation during the putting stroke. Completing the package is a new textured Full Contact Slim grip, a custom shaft band, and a dedicated headcover. Available in both right and left-handed options, the Studio Style Catalina offers a clean, confidence-inspiring look with high MOI performance.

Material: 303 stainless steel with new Studio Carbon Steel (SCS) face inlay

The Mitsubishi Rayon Diamana RB (Red Board) Driver Shaft combines classic Diamana branding and weight class designations with cutting-edge materials and engineering. As the third profile in the newest generation, the RB offers a slightly higher launch angle than the BB, promoting ease of launch while maintaining down-field control. This classic "Red Board" profile, reminiscent of the 2nd Generation Diamana, features an active, softer tip section for enhanced feel and launch, while still incorporating the same material technology and low-torque characteristics as its lower-launching 6th Generation counterparts. Key features include 80-ton DIALEAD Pitch Fiber in the butt section for maximum stability and energy transfer, high modulus 46-ton fiber in the angle plies to lower torque without adding weight, and the Xlink Tech™ Resin System for increased shaft strength and durability. The shaft's flex profile is stiffer in the butt and middle sections and soft in the tip, contributing to its launch characteristics and overall feel.

products.name: L.A.B. Golf OZ.1 Counterbalance Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The L.A.B. Golf OZ.1 Counterbalance putter is designed for golfers seeking enhanced stability and control in their putting stroke. The added weight in the grip end helps to smooth out inconsistencies and minimize unwanted movement, leading to a more reliable and repeatable motion. This design also reduces tension in the hands and wrists, promoting a more relaxed and fluid stroke. Players who value a solid feel and a stable putter head will appreciate the OZ.1's solid-body construction and lie angle balance, promoting consistent accuracy and distance control. The classic half-moon mallet shape appeals to those seeking a traditional aesthetic with modern performance benefits. Like other L.A.B. Golf putters, the OZ.1 Counterbalance offers exceptional forgiveness, making it ideal for golfers of all skill levels.
The Tech Story
L.A.B. Golf had always aspired to craft a tour-inspired putter, driven by a fascination with the nuanced preferences of professional golfers. This ambition led them to collaborate with Adam Scott, who envisioned a putter with design cues from a German sports car and a classic mallet. Through iterative prototyping, feedback and a deep understanding of Lie Angle Balance, the OZ.1 was born, their first half-moon style mallet featuring a solid-body construction for exceptional feel and stability. Maintaining the forgiveness of their acclaimed DF3 and MEZZ.1 MAX putters, the OZ.1 ensures optimal accuracy and roll. The OZ.1i comes with a stainless steel insert for a firmer feel and faster ball speeds, while the all-aluminum OZ.1 Custom and OZ.1 Stock models offer a softer feel. In terms of size and shape, OZ.1i and OZ.1 are exactly the same. For the ultimate in personalized performance, the OZ.1i Custom and OZ.1 Custom are available with two shaft lean options. Choose the 0-Degree (Vertical) Shaft Lean for a traditional look and compatibility with standard grips, or the 2-Degree Shaft Lean, like our DF3, designed for use with a Press Grip. Experience the unique blend of classic design, innovative technology, and personalized performance with the L.A.B. Golf OZ.1i putter.

Experience the pinnacle of putting performance with the Mizuno M.Craft X P6. This fang-shaped mallet putter, featuring a plumber's neck hosel, is designed for golfers with a slight arc in their putting stroke. It expertly combines the precision of a blade with the forgiveness of a mallet, giving you ultimate control over every putt.
The Tech Story
The Mizuno M.Craft X Putter line delivers the best of both worlds, providing the feel and control of a blade with the forgiveness and stability of a mallet. This is achieved through a dynamically shallow center of gravity, a larger head design, and customizable weights that allow golfers to fine-tune feel and performance. Forged and CNC-milled from 1025 steel, the M.Craft X ensures exceptional feel, responsiveness, and consistent roll control. A lightweight aluminum back enhances MOI for increased forgiveness, while the Lamkin Sink Fit grip with a 1906 mosaic pattern adds a touch of Mizuno's heritage. Further customization is available with three neck styles (Plumber, Slant, and Bend) and three unique back shapes (Four, Five and Six) allowing golfers to optimize the putter for their stroke and preference. The result is a putter that is both a work of art and a performance powerhouse, seamlessly blending tradition and technology.

products.name: Callaway Reva Rise Iron Set
products.description:
Who’s it For?
The Callaway Reva Rise Irons are designed for women golfers of all skill levels who are seeking to improve their scoring through more forgiving and easier-to-launch irons. The Ai-optimized faces, incorporating women's fitting data, provide enhanced ball speed, spin, and forgiveness for consistent distance and performance, while the overall design promotes effortless launch and added spin for better control and the ability to hold greens.
The Tech Story
The Callaway Reva Rise Irons are meticulously engineered to simplify scoring for women golfers through a combination of forgiving design and advanced technology. The irons feature an Ai 10x Face, an AI-optimized design that utilizes extensive women's fitting data to enhance ball speed, spin consistency, and forgiveness across the face of each iron. This personalized optimization delivers consistent and reliable performance, contributing to improved distance control and the added spin necessary to effectively hold greens. products.name: Mizuno JPX 925 Forged Iron Set
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Mizuno has always been synonymous with innovation and craftsmanship, and this is epitomized in the JPX 925 Forged irons. Designed for more skilled or low-to-mid handicap players seeking the ultimate in feel and precision and to those looking for more forgiveness and distance than a standard players iron. The new build features cater to players who demand exceptional performance and workability in their players-distance irons. Whether you're shaping shots into the green or seeking consistent ball striking, the JPX 925 Forged irons offer a powerful blend of technology and craftsmanship to your game.
The Tech Story
The Mizuno JPX 925 Forged irons represent a significant leap forward in forged iron technology, seamlessly blending Mizuno's renowned craftsmanship with cutting-edge design. The innovative CORTECH Design, featuring a Contour Ellipse Face, optimizes ball speed across the entire face for exceptional distance and forgiveness, even on off-center hits. This groundbreaking face technology is achieved through new construction methods, pushing the boundaries of forged iron performance. Furthermore, the JPX 925 Forged irons are Grain Flow Forged HD from Chromoly 4120 in the long irons (4-7) for enhanced speed and adjustability, while the shorter irons (8-GW) utilize 1025E Pure Select Mild Carbon Steel for precision, control, and that signature Mizuno feel. The meticulously engineered Triple Cut Sole enhances turf interaction and playability from any lie, and the classic Satin Chrome finish provides a timeless aesthetic.

products.name: TaylorMade Qi35 Rescue Hybrid
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The TaylorMade Qi35 Rescue Hybrid is designed for golfers of all skill levels seeking versatility and forgiveness in a hybrid club. Its confidence-inspiring shape and advanced technologies make it a great option for players who want to improve performance from a variety of lies, including the rough and fairway. The adjustable loft sleeve adds to its adaptability, allowing golfers to fine-tune trajectory and distance. Whether you struggle with long irons or simply want a more forgiving option, the TaylorMade Qi35 Rescue Hybrid can help you achieve consistent and confident results.
The Tech Story
The TaylorMade Qi35 Rescue Hybrid is engineered to inspire confidence and deliver exceptional performance from any lie. Its advanced multi-material construction, utilizing chromium carbon, steel, and aluminum, creates an optimal blend of form and function, ensuring playability in various conditions. The incorporation of a 3° loft sleeve across all lofts allows golfers to fine-tune their distance, trajectory, and preferred face angle for maximum control and versatility. The integrated TSS weighting system enables precise swing weight adjustments during assembly, providing golfers with a personalized feel and optimal control. A confidence-inspiring address shape, combined with technologies like Twist Face and Thru-Slot Speed Pocket, further enhances performance and forgiveness, making the Qi35 Rescue Hybrid an ideal choice for golfers seeking consistent and reliable results from any lie.

Swingweight: D2 - D3

products.name: TaylorMade Qi35 Driver
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The TaylorMade Qi35 driver is designed for a wide range of golfers seeking high launch, low spin, and maximum forgiveness. Its combination of advanced technologies, including the near-zero CG projection, high MOI, and Carbon Twist Face, promotes straighter shots and increased distance. The Qi35 prioritizes ease of use and forgiveness while still offering some adjustability, making it a great option for players who want to improve consistency and gain confidence off the tee.
The Tech Story
The TaylorMade Qi35 driver is engineered for golfers seeking optimal launch conditions and maximum forgiveness. Its multi-material construction, seamlessly blending chromium carbon, steel, aluminum, tungsten, and titanium, optimizes performance and creates a visually appealing design. The driver's near-zero CG projection, coupled with high MOI, promotes efficient launch and spin across a larger area of the face, resulting in straighter, longer shots. A Trajectory Adjustment System with two moveable weights allows for personalized spin and shot shape control, adapting to individual playing styles and course conditions. The fourth-generation Carbon Twist Face enhances energy transfer and promotes straighter shots, while the high-inertia shape provides exceptional stability and forgiveness. Integrated technologies like the Thru-Slot Speed Pocket and Infinity Carbon Crown further contribute to ball speed and overall performance, making the Qi35 a powerful and forgiving driver for a wide range of golfers.

Launch: Mid-High

products.name: Cleveland HB Soft 2 Black Retreve Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Cleveland HB Soft 2 Black Retreve Putter is specifically designed for golfers who prefer a face-balanced putter with a straight-back, straight-through putting stroke. Its unique design feature allows golfers to easily pick up their ball from the hole without bending over, making it ideal for those seeking convenience and ease of use on the green.
The Tech Story
Cleveland HB SOFT 2 Black Putters offer a premium putting experience with their black satin finish and multi-material UST Mamiya ALL-IN shaft, providing enhanced stability and feel. The putters leverage Speed Optimized Face Technology, a dynamic groove milling pattern that normalizes ball speed across the face for consistent distance performance. With nine unique head shapes, each putter is tailored to specific stroke types, featuring corresponding hosel styles, toe hang, alignment systems, and grips. This ensures optimal performance for straight or slight arc strokes. Additionally, a 20g weight in the butt end of the shaft for models 35" and over guarantees a consistent swing feel across all putter lengths.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
The L.A.B. Golf OZ.1i Counterbalance putter is designed for golfers seeking enhanced stability and control in their putting stroke. The added weight in the grip end helps to smooth out inconsistencies and minimize unwanted movement, leading to a more reliable and repeatable motion. This design also reduces tension in the hands and wrists, promoting a more relaxed and fluid stroke. Players who value a solid feel and a stable putter head will appreciate the OZ.1i's solid-body construction and lie angle balance, promoting consistent accuracy and distance control. The classic half-moon mallet shape appeals to those seeking a traditional aesthetic with modern performance benefits. The stainless steel insert provides a firmer feel and faster ball speeds, catering to players who prefer that distinct response. Like other L.A.B. Golf putters, the OZ.1i offers exceptional forgiveness, making it ideal for golfers of all skill levels.
The Tech Story
L.A.B. Golf had always aspired to craft a tour-inspired putter, driven by a fascination with the nuanced preferences of professional golfers. This ambition led them to collaborate with Adam Scott, who envisioned a putter with design cues from a German sports car and a classic mallet. Through iterative prototyping, feedback and a deep understanding of Lie Angle Balance, the OZ.1 was born, their first half-moon style mallet featuring a solid-body construction for exceptional feel and stability. Maintaining the forgiveness of their acclaimed DF3 and MEZZ.1 MAX putters, the OZ.1 ensures optimal accuracy and roll. The OZ.1i comes with a stainless steel insert for a firmer feel and faster ball speeds, while the all-aluminum OZ.1 Custom and OZ.1 Stock models offer a softer feel. In terms of size and shape, OZ.1i and OZ.1 are exactly the same. For the ultimate in personalized performance, the OZ.1i Custom and OZ.1 Custom are available with two shaft lean options. Choose the 0-Degree (Vertical) Shaft Lean for a traditional look and compatibility with standard grips, or the 2-Degree Shaft Lean, like our DF3, designed for use with a Press Grip. Experience the unique blend of classic design, innovative technology, and personalized performance with the L.A.B. Golf OZ.1i putter.

Who’s It For?
The Evnroll Zero Z2s putter caters to golfers seeking enhanced accuracy and consistency on the green. Its design, featuring FaceForward Technology and Zero Torque, minimizes face rotation and the impact of off-center hits, making it suitable for players of all skill levels. The high MOI and SweetFace Technology further contribute to stability and consistent ball speeds, even on mis-hits. Golfers struggling with maintaining a square putter face, seeking a stable stroke, or frequently hitting off-center will find this putter particularly beneficial.
The Tech Story
The Evnroll Zero putters are designed for ultimate accuracy and consistency. The Face Forward Technology virtually eliminates face rotation, keeping your putts on track by aligning the shaft with the putter head's center of mass. This translates to straighter putts and fewer misses, even with off-center hits. The secret lies in the unique reverse plumber-neck hosel and SweetFace Technology, which combine to deliver uniform energy transfer across the entire face for consistent distance and zero dispersion. With high MOI for incredible stability and customizable swing weights, the Evnroll Zero Putters offer personalized feel and unparalleled control.

Additionally, Harmonic Impact Technology fine-tunes the head geometry to deliver the ideal feel and feedback at impact, ensuring a satisfying and responsive experience for the player.

The Mizuno JPX 925 Hot Metal redefines the performance of an already industry-leading franchise. By blending the power and speed of Nickel Chromoly with a newly designed CORTECH face featuring a Contour Ellipse, it delivers unmatched consistency in distance across the entire impact zone. A Seamless Cup Face geometry extends the thinned areas 360 degrees around the perimeter, boosting rebound for maximum ball speed across the entire face. The Variable Sole Thickness increases the overall face flex area, further enhancing the CORAREA. The Balanced Stability Frame ensures control while maintaining forgiveness, complemented by Harmonic Impact Technology and Acoustic Sound Ribs for an ideal feel, feedback, and explosive impact sound. products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Mizuno JPX 925 Hot Metal redefines the performance of an already industry-leading franchise. By blending the power and speed of Nickel Chromoly with a newly designed CORTECH face featuring a Contour Ellipse, it delivers unmatched consistency in distance across the entire impact zone. The inclusion of tungsten weighting, positioned low in the clubhead, enhances height and landing angles, making it easier than ever to hit precise shots into greens. The Hot Metal Pro is one of three models within the JPX 925 line and is designed for mid-to-high handicap players that are seeking a high-launching, forgiving iron, but in a slimmer, more compact profile.
The Tech Story
The Mizuno JPX 925 Hot Metal irons represent a pinnacle of innovation, combining advanced materials and cutting-edge design for superior performance. At the core is the CORTECH Design featuring a Contour Ellipse Face, a completely re-engineered multi-thickness profile that is 30% thinner than previous generations. This design maximizes ball speed retention across the impact zone. The Chromoly 4140M material offers a high-strength face with a bendable hosel, enhancing custom fitting options. A Seamless Cup Face geometry extends the thinned areas 360 degrees around the perimeter, boosting rebound for maximum ball speed across the entire face. Tungsten weighting in the 4-7 irons is strategically positioned low, creating a higher launch and steeper landing angles. The Variable Sole Thickness increases the overall face flex area, further enhancing the CORAREA. The Balanced Stability Frame ensures control while maintaining forgiveness, complemented by Harmonic Impact Technology and Acoustic Sound Ribs for an ideal feel, feedback, and explosive impact sound. Finished with a sleek White Satin Brush, these irons offer both modern aesthetics and durability.

products.name: L.A.B. Golf DF3 Sweeper Putter
products.description:
Who’s It For?
L.A.B. Golf’s newest release the DF3 has incorporated everything golfers loved about the original Lie Angle Balanced Directed Force, but now comes in a smaller, sleeker, though similar design to the L.A.B. putter that started it all. It still stays square by itself and is irrationally forgiving on mishits, but now suits more golfers thanks to a more visually appealing, less bulky design.
The Tech Story
The L.A.B. Golf DF3 embodies the pinnacle of putting technology, integrating advanced features to redefine precision on the greens. At its core lies the groundbreaking Lie Angle Balance technology, which strategically redistributes weight towards the rear of the putter head, minimizing torque and promoting a smoother, more stable putting stroke. products.name: Ping Prodi G Junior Wedge
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Introducing the new 2024 Prodi G junior clubs! These clubs feature all the advanced technology and power of PING’s renowned G series, and have been expertly refined and optimized for young golfers. Every club, from driver to putter, is meticulously crafted at PING headquarters and fully customized to your child's exact specifications.
The Tech Story
The 2024 PING Prodi G line, where PING’s renowned technology meets junior golfers' specific needs. The Prodi G Driver boasts a thinner Ti 6-4 face and innovative Spinsistency technology, providing faster ball speeds and greater distance. Its lower center of gravity (CG) and higher moment of inertia (MOI) ensure exceptional forgiveness, while crown turbulators, a lighter head, and a lightweight graphite shaft enhance speed in this G Series-inspired 460cc design. The 15° loft optimizes launch conditions for maximum performance. The Prodi G Irons feature a lower CG for increased ball speed and easy launch, with heel-toe weighting for forgiveness from the cast 17-4 stainless steel body. More bounce across the set improves turf interaction and solid contact, while custom-engineered lofts ensure proper spin and gapping. The head is sized for a perfect blend of playability and forgiveness. The Prodi G Fairway club makes launching the ball high and far off the turf easy, thanks to its lower CG and Spinsistency for consistent spin and longer carries from the 22° 17-4 stainless steel head. A slightly larger, lighter head increases forgiveness and ball speed, helping juniors square the face at impact. The Prodi G Hybrid, designed with juniors in mind, features a 28° loft for peak height and spin, ensuring excellent greenside performance. A lower CG generates faster ball speeds across the face, filling the crucial gap between the fairway wood and 6-iron. The Prodi G Wedges, with their tour-winning s159 wedge inspiration, offer versatility, optimized spin, and control. The 54° and 58° specialty wedges provide high-performance friction faces for enhanced spin in all conditions. The 58° wedge, with its H grind (half-moon), ensures easy execution from bunkers by providing heel relief for smooth sand play. To complete their Prodi G bag, juniors can choose between two exceptional putters: The Prodi G Anser Putter, known for its consistent performance and tour-proven design, features heel-toe weighting in its 320-gram, 17-4 stainless steel head for high forgiveness. A single alignment line aids in easy aiming, and its slight-arc stroke type allows the golfer to feel some face rotation during the stroke, building confidence for young golfers. The Prodi G Tyne H Putter, with its contemporary mid-mallet twin-fork footprint, offers a ball-width alignment aid for easy setup and aiming. This design provides perimeter weighting for increased forgiveness from the highly stable, 340-gram, 17-4 stainless steel head. Its slight-arc stroke type also helps juniors feel some face rotation during the stroke, making it ideal for younger players.
Facts and Figures
Available Sets: 51” Package, 54” Package, 57” Package
51” Package: Driver (R Flex, -4.25”), Hybrid (R Flex, -3”), 6 Iron, 8 Iron, PW, 54° (All -3”), Tyne H Putter (-3”)
54” Package: Driver (R Flex, -2.25”), Hybrid (R Flex. -1.5”), 6 Iron, 8 Iron, PW, 54° (All -1.5”), Tyne H Putter (-1.5”)
57” Package: Driver (S Flex), Hybrid (S Flex), 6 Iron, 8 Iron, PW, 54°, Tyne H Putter (All Standard Length)
*See other Prodi G sets for custom ordering options
Get Golf Growing Program
As junior golfers grow, so does the need to ensure they are properly fit to their equipment. When you purchase a Prodi G set, you are entitled to a one-time, no-charge club adjustment service. Clubs can be re-shafted or lengthened, re-weighted and regripped to optimize performance as your child grows.
WebFit Wedge App
The value of custom fitting juniors as they’re learning the game and growing quickly is we get
them in the perfect equipment for their age and ability. Using PING WebFit Junior, our digital
fitting tool, you answer a few quick questions about your junior golfer, and our algorithms will
determine set configuration, shaft length, iron lie angles, and more.

products.name: TPT Golf Power Range Driver Shaft
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The TPT Golf Power Range Driver Shaft is designed for golfers seeking exceptional stability and consistency in their game. Engineered to deliver high launch with low spin for maximum carry, it suits virtually any swing type. Its advanced manufacturing process ensures a perfectly balanced shaft, giving players optimal control and precision. Ideal for those taking their first step into TPT technology, this shaft offers high stability and performance for golfers who value accuracy and dependable results.
The Tech Story
The TPT Golf Power Range Driver Shaft is built on Thin Ply Technology (TPT), an advanced process that uses ultra-thin graphite fiber plies—twice as thin as traditional graphite—to create a more uniform and precise structure, much like sharpening an image’s resolution. Originally developed for high-performance industries such as aerospace, motorsport, and elite sail racing, this technology delivers immediate feedback and enhanced club head awareness, allowing golfers to swing with confidence while the shaft maintains consistent strike locations. TPT’s breakthrough lies in its automated, spine-free design, achieved by perfectly aligning fibers along the shaft’s axis during winding on a conical mandrel, eliminating parasitic bending and ensuring 0° fiber deviation. This innovation, combined with a low-torque profile, provides unmatched stability and consistency, enabling players to use softer shafts for improved control and distance. The Power Range offers models from 14 to 21, spanning the stiffest and heaviest to the softest and lightest options, and comes in Hi or Lo series to match individual launch preferences.

products.name: Bettinardi MB24 Iron Set
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Bettinardi's commitment to innovation and craftsmanship remains steadfast. Their 2024 irons are the culmination of over 30 years of expertise in metal machining and a quarter-century of dedication to the game of golf. Using their proprietary One Piece Forging Technology, these seamlessly co-forged irons employ a tri-material construction to individually optimize the center of gravity (COG) across the set, delivering maximum forgiveness, tight dispersion, and consistent gapping. The Bettinardi MB24 Irons are a traditional muscle back blade iron and are best suited for low-handicap players that are seeking consistency and workability in an iron.
The Tech Story
The Bettinardi 2024 Irons showcase advanced technology, starting with the One Piece Co-Forged Solid Body. This unique engineering technique seamlessly co-forges interior components within a 1025 Carbon Steel chassis, creating a solid-body iron that offers a remarkable feel and responsive feedback for the player. The tri-material construction combines high-density Tungsten and Military-Grade Ceramic Matrix Composite (CMC) within the forged Carbon Steel body, resulting in balanced weight distribution that enhances forgiveness while maintaining consistency across the set. Progressive COG Positioning uses loft-dependent placement of Tungsten and CMC components to ensure precise center of gravity (COG) in each iron, promoting more launch in the long irons, controlled backspin in the scoring irons, and consistent gapping throughout the set. The modern head shape, with its clean aesthetics, boosts confidence at address and encourages a higher launch trajectory, leading to greater distance and improved performance on every shot.

The TaylorMade P-DHY Utility Iron redefines long iron performance with its innovative technology and design. Its shallower face height, increased sole width, and longer blade length combine to create a remarkably forgiving and versatile club, perfect for players seeking consistency and control. Engineered with a low CG, this iron delivers mid-high launch and mid-range spin, optimizing trajectory and distance. The Thru-Slot Speed Pocket™ technology enhances face flexibility, preserving ball speed and distance even on low face strikes, making the TaylorMade P-DHY Utility Iron a game-changing addition to any golfer's bag.

Golf’s newest release the DF3 has incorporated everything golfers loved about the original Lie Angle Balanced Directed Force, but now comes in a smaller, sleeker, though similar design to the L.A.B. putter that started it all. The Tech Story
The L.A.B. Golf DF3 embodies the pinnacle of putting technology, integrating advanced features to redefine precision on the greens. At its core lies the groundbreaking Lie Angle Balance technology, which strategically redistributes weight towards the rear of the putter head, minimizing torque and promoting a smoother, more stable putting stroke. This innovative design enhances consistency and accuracy, enabling golfers to achieve optimal roll characteristics with every putt. The DF3 boasts a smaller, sleeker body design compared to its predecessor, while still enhancing forgiveness and performance on off-center strikes. Its re-engineered shaft attachment system offers increased adjustability, allowing golfers to tailor their setup to suit their stroke preferences. Additionally, the DF3 features an updated alignment aid for improved visual alignment assistance, ensuring precise aim and confidence at address. Crafted with aerospace-grade materials and precision engineering, the L.A.B. products.name: Ping ChipR LE Chipper
products.description:
Who’s It For?
After introducing the ChipR in 2022, PING has released the ChipR Le, a short-game solution designed exclusively for women. It combines elements of a putter and a wedge to help golfers perform better around the green. It is designed for players of all skill levels.
The Tech Story
The ChipR Le was inspired by PING Founder Karsten Solheim’s PING Chipo, which was introduced in the late 1970’s, as a club for players that lacked confidence with a wedge around the green.The ChipR Le features an Investment-cast 431 stainless steel head. Within that head is a multi-material cavity badge, tungsten toe weight and a precision-milled face and grooves, which help deliver consistent and predictable trajectories for improved control around the green. The ChipR Le is the length of a putter, but has a loft of 38.5°, closer to a 9-iron. Designed for shots within 40 yards of the green, players can use a putting-like stroke to hit more bump-and-run style shots. That’s aided by the ChipR Le’s compact size and shallow face which optimizes its performance, and provides versatility from the rough to the fringe.

For the most part, PING has stayed away from producing a true blade iron design. However, the PING Blueprint irons are truly a forged blade construction that fits the eye of the best ball strikers in the world. These irons are designed to promote precision and workability above all else. Low-handicap golfers who frequently find the center of the face and want more trajectory control will want to check out the Blueprint irons. Mid- to high-handicap golfers will want to try the PING G410 irons.

To provide the clean, small profile at address, PING developed the heads with shorter blade lengths and narrower sole lengths than any of its previous iron sets. The face contains machined grooves for added spin and control. In terms of appearance, the Blueprint irons feature a beautiful hydropearl 2.0 chrome finish that is pleasing to the eye.

products.name: Ping Blueprint S Single Iron
products.description:
Who’s It For?
The new Blueprint S Irons are PING’s latest players iron, and while they have all of the classic features of a traditional players iron, the Blueprint S’s deviate away from the original Blueprint irons with a cavity-style head. Feel and workability remain important tenets of the Blueprint S irons, but come with more forgiveness than their predecessor, making them an iron for consistent ball-strikers who still favor that feel and workability, but are looking for a slightly more forgiving option than a true blade.
The Tech Story
The Blueprint S’s feature a fully forged 8620 carbon steel head with a clean hydropearl 2.0 chrome finish. The cavity-style is present in all irons in the set, though the long irons (3-5) contain a patented precision-pocket forging, which saves 10 grams of weight, and increases forgiveness. Minimal offset and a thin top-line give the Blueprint S’s a pleasing sightline at address. The Blueprint S’s can come in three different specs: Standard, Power (stronger lofts), and Retro (weaker lofts). Combination sets have become the norm across all manufacturers, and the Blueprint S’s along with its Blueprint T relative, and the Ping i230 are all designed with the same lofts, allowing for golfers to blend their Blueprint S’s with other models for a perfect set tailored to each golfer.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
Building upon its Paradym Iron series, Callaway has continued to push the envelope with AI designed clubs with their new Paradym Ai Smoke line. With the most advanced iron face in Callaway history, the Ai Smoke line offers players more distance and accuracy without sacrificing forgiveness. The Ai Smoke Irons are one of three models within the series, and are best suited for players with average to high swing speeds who are looking to maximize distance and improve their dispersion.

Everything within the Paradym Ai Smoke Iron line begins with the all-new Ai SmartFace. Its AI design was developed using swing data from thousands of golfers. Balancing distance, control and precision was the primary focus of the Ai Smoke Irons’ design. With the clubs playing a ¼ inch longer, players can experience the distance advantage while still maintaining a tight dispersion into the green. Its modern shaping featuring longer blade lengths, thinner toplines and optimized sole create a forgiving, yet aesthetically pleasing look at address. Combining that with its hollow-body construction, and the Ai Smoke Irons perfectly blend form with function. An all-new Dynamic Sole Design featuring a pre-worn leading edge with variable bounce allows for better turf interaction, better contact and improved forgiveness.

products.name: Ping G LE 3 Driver
products.description:
Who’s It For?
PING has long been one of the golf equipment leaders when it comes to performance for every type of golfer. The PING G Le3 line represents the latest advancement in golf club performance for women. The lightweight, easy-to-swing clubs rely on the proven success of the PING G430 technology and deliver added distance and unmatched forgiveness. The PING G Le3 driver will best fit women golfers looking to add distance and forgiveness off the tee. Junior golfers and teen golfers may also see the same benefits playing a G Le3 driver.
The Tech Story
The PING G Le3 line represents the latest advancement in golf club performance for women. In the driver, it means, higher, longer, and straighter results off the tee. This is generated by a lighter overall club build that naturally boosts swing speed. Furthermore, crown turbulators and a Vortec cavity add swing speed through aerodynamic efficiency. Meanwhile, the G Le3 driver features a forged face optimized to get the best performance possible from swing speeds of 80 miles per hour or less. A fixed back weight lowers the center of gravity and creates a slight draw bias for golfers that might struggle with a slice. The Trajectory Tuning 2.0 hosel allows for loft and lie adjustability to allow golfers to dial in their launch and trajectory.
Facts and Figures
Clubhead Size: 460cc
Loft: 11.5 degrees (adjustable +/- 1.5)
Head Weight: 190 grams
Avg. Lie Angle: 58.5 degrees
Shaft Info
Stock Shaft: ULT 250 (L-flex and UL flex)
Shaft weight: 52 grams (L-flex), 44 grams (UL-flex)
Standard Length: 44.75 inches
Standard Swingweight: C2

2nd Swing offers award-winning club fitting services at each of our store locations and through the 2nd Swing Online Fitting and Support team on 2ndswing.com. Make sure your equipment is fit for your game and schedule your award-winning fitting experience by calling (612) 216-4152 or by visiting the 2nd Swing fitting website: https://www.2ndswing.com/golf-club-fittings.

products.description:
Who’s It For?
The Miura KM-700 Iron Set is designed for golfers who demand precision, consistency, and craftsmanship at the highest level. After five years of development, Katsuhiro Miura created a revolutionary design that naturally delivers the clubhead square at impact, optimizing accuracy and control without altering a player’s swing. This performance is achieved through Miura’s proprietary manufacturing techniques and the meticulous grinding expertise of its master craftsmen, ensuring perfect weight distribution and balance. The KM-700 is ideal for players seeking a blend of traditional feel and modern innovation, allowing golfers of all skill levels to maximize their game with unmatched quality and performance.
The Tech Story
The Miura KM-700 Irons represent a breakthrough in design and craftsmanship, delivering optimized performance and forgiveness for golfers of all skill levels. Featuring a unique back shape and weight distribution, these irons precisely position the center of gravity for each loft, promoting a natural return to square at impact for improved accuracy. A revolutionary hosel and heel design shifts the CG 3mm closer to the toe, creating a larger sweet spot for straighter, longer shots—even on off-center strikes. Enhanced playability is paired with meticulous attention to detail, including numerous head iterations during a five-year development process guided by Katsuhiro Miura and his protégés. This pursuit of perfection is honored by Miura-san’s iconic red hanko stamp on every iron, signifying unmatched craftsmanship and performance.

Who’s it For?
For the skilled golfer who demands the ultimate in feel and control, the Z-Forged II Irons are a traditional muscle back blade designed with direct input from Srixon's tour professionals. Achieve crisp feedback, maximum command, and the ability to shape shots with pinpoint accuracy.
The Tech Story
The Srixon Z Forged II Irons are meticulously crafted for skilled players, beginning with a precision forging of 1020 Carbon Steel to deliver a premium feel and exceptional playability, developed in close collaboration with Srixon's tour professionals as a highly workable muscle back blade. This enhanced feel is further amplified by PureFrame technology, a strategic shaping feature that adds mass directly behind the impact zone for unmatched feedback and performance. The irons boast a contemporary blade shaping with a compact profile and clean address, while the back cavity design optimizes the Center of Gravity (CG) and Moment of Inertia (MOI) without compromising feel or workability. Performance is further optimized through Progressive Grooves, featuring wider grooves in the longer irons (3i-7i) for consistent performance in all conditions and deeper, closer-set grooves in the short irons (8i-PW) to enhance spin on approach shots, complemented by laser milling between all grooves for increased friction. Finally, the Tour V.T. Sole, a proprietary design incorporating specific sole widths, bounce angles, and toe/heel notches, ensures exceptional turf interaction, allowing for a smooth glide through various lies and promoting solid, speed-retaining contact.

Are you a golfer seeking the ultimate edge on the greens? Look no further than the L.A.B. Its aerospace-grade construction combines lightweight durability with strategic weight distribution, allowing for enhanced feel and responsiveness on every stroke. The sleek, aerodynamic contours of the putter head not only exude visual appeal but also optimize clubhead speed through the impact zone, resulting in increased distance control and accuracy. Each component of the MEZZ.1 MAX is thoughtfully designed and meticulously assembled, culminating in a putter that transcends mere equipment and becomes an extension of the golfer's skill and determination. products.name: Garmin Approach G12 GPS Device
products.description:
We’ve got your game with the Approach G12 golf range finder. Clip the thin GPS device to your pocket, or use the lanyard loop to mount it on a golf bag to see distances to the green at a glance — for up to 30 hours on a single charge. Use Big Numbers Mode to display accurate yardages for more than 42,000 preloaded courses. See positions of the hazards and doglegs on a hole, so you can find the best way to navigate each shot. Pair with Approach CT10 club tracking sensors (sold separately) to automatically track your shots and sync game data to the Garmin Golf™ app.
Overview:
42,000+ PRELOADED COURSES - This range finder comes preloaded with more than 42,000 CourseView maps for golf courses around the world. When paired with the Garmin Golf app, wirelessly download updates for the courses you play most often.
GREEN VIEW - The Green View feature gives you each green’s true shape from wherever you are on the course, and it allows you to drag-and-drop the pin for greater accuracy.
ACCURATE MEASUREMENTS - Find the best way to navigate each shot with exact yardages to the front, back and middle of the green and positions of the hazards and doglegs on a hole.
BIG NUMBERS MODE - This feature increases the type size, making it easier to read yardage numbers to the front, back and middle of the green.
GARMIN GOLF APP - Pair with the Garmin Golf app on your compatible smartphone for strokes gained analysis, to participate in leaderboards and tournaments and to gain more data about your game.
DIGITAL SCORECARD - Your device keeps score so you can always know where you stand. Upload directly to the Garmin Golf app to participate in weekly leaderboards.
CLUB TRACKING - Pair with a full set of Approach CT10 club tracking sensors for more tracking capabilities (sold separately).
BATTERY LIFE - The Approach G12 handheld’s rechargeable battery lasts up to 30 hours in GPS mode.
WEATHER-READY - This range finder is IPX7 water-rated so you can keep playing, even in the rain.
IN THE BOX:
- Approach G12
- Charging/data cable
- Documentation

products.name: Garmin Approach Z82 Rangefinder
products.description:
The Approach Z82 laser range finder with GPS gives you the most accurate reading on the market within10” of the flag.
OVERVIEW:
GREEN VIEW - The map overlays show the hole layout, so you know the distance to the back, middle and front of the green.
LASER RANGE ARC - The Laser Range Arc feature draws an arc on the 2-D CourseView map at the distance the laser ranged, so you can see everything in play at that distance.
HAZARD VIEW - Quickly scroll through each hazard and layup distance on the map to see how far it is to reach each one.
ACCOUNT FOR WIND - The range finder now displays wind speed and direction, which makes figuring out which club to use and which direction to swing much easier.
PLAYSLIKE DISTANCE - This feature adjusts yardages for uphill or downhill shots based on the change in elevation from where you are standing to the target.
FIND THE PIN - On blind shots, the PinPointer feature will tell you the direction to the pin. So even if you can’t see, you’ll know where to aim.
LOCK IN ON THE FLAG - Image stabilization makes it easier to find and range the flag. And when you lock in on it, vibrational feedback will let you know.
41K+ PRELOADED COURSES - Your range finder comes preloaded with more than 41,000 full-color CourseView maps from around the world.
TOURNAMENT MODE - An external indicator light — which can be turned on and off — lets you and your playing partners know when you’re in tournament mode.
FIND MY GARMIN - If you ever accidentally leave your range finder on the course, use the Find My Garmin feature to quickly locate your device.
KEEP SCORE - Use the Garmin Golf app to keep score and participate in weekly leaderboards with friends and family.

products.name: Miura PI-401 Iron Set
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Miura is renowned for its ultra-premium quality irons, but the manufacturer doesn’t make clubs solely for ultra-low handicappers. The new Miura PI-401 Irons combine cutting-edge, forgiving technology with the classically soft and responsive feel found in all Miuras. Clubmaker Shinei Miura also made sure to maximize the distance capabilities of the PI-401s. Overall, these irons are a superb option for middle- and high-handicappers that want powerful and forgiving irons that refuse to compromise any feel.
The Tech Story
The Miura PI-401 Irons feature a fast clubface made from S35C carbon steel. The optimal thickness of the high-quality metal enlarges the sweet spot of each club and makes it easy to launch the ball high in the air and stop it quickly on the greens. Another critical aspect that Miura’s engineers keyed in on during the design process was the iron’s groundbreaking sole design. The new sole sports four different angles, including a leading-edge grind that reduces turf resistance through the strike. As a result of the enhanced turf interaction, golfers will achieve their desired trajectory more often. The innovative technologies found in the new Miura PI-401 Irons work hand-in-hand to cement the model’s status as a premier option for golfers.
Facts and Figures

Category: Game-Improvement
Construction: Forged
Stock Shaft: Variety of Shafts Offered

Who’s It For?
The Allison putter model from Indi golf is a rounded mallet shape built from aircraft grade aluminum with tungsten weighting added in the toe and heel. The Allison putter is designed specifically for golfers with a moderate arc in their putting strokes due to the 35 degrees of toe hang. Additionally, this putter is available in a matte black or satin chrome color. Golfers interested in the Indi craftsmanship but prefer a blade would prefer the Ramone blade model, while golfers that need a face-balanced design would gravitate toward the standard Allison model.
The Tech Story
The Indi golf putters are designed to deliver exceptional performance through tremendous craftsmanship and strong materials. The clubfaces are precision CNC milled to provide soft feel and promote clean roll at impact. The aircraft grade aluminum construction with tungsten weighting located in the toe and heel helps create the Colossal Sweet Spot, which promotes distance consistency regardless of where the ball is struck on the clubface. Additionally, the tungsten weighting promotes stroke repeatability and unmatched consistency.

products.name: Fujikura Motore X F3 Driver Shaft
products.description:
Fujikura Motore X F3 Driver Shaft
The Fujikura Motore X F3 driver shaft is a high-performance option designed for golfers with faster swing speeds who demand exceptional stability and a penetrating ball flight. As part of the renowned Motore X line, it utilizes advanced materials and a mid-launch profile to help you maximize distance and control.
Features:
ENSO® Technology: Fujikura's proprietary high-speed motion capture system ensures optimal energy transfer and stability at impact, leading to faster ball speeds and tighter dispersion.
Accelerated Taper: The shaft's taper design enhances energy transfer, boosting ball speeds for more distance while maintaining stability for tighter shot control.
Reinforced Bias Core: A torsionally stiffened handle section promotes faster ball speeds and a balanced torsional strength for stability.
Mid Launch: Specifically designed to produce a mid launch trajectory for a powerful and penetrating ball flight.
Low-Mid Spin: Reduces unwanted spin for a penetrating ball flight and greater accuracy.
Benefits:
Explosive distance: Achieve maximum yardage with a powerful, penetrating ball flight.
Improved accuracy: The mid launch and low-mid spin promote a more consistent ball flight and tighter dispersion.
Enhanced feel: Experience a smooth, responsive feel for exceptional feedback and confidence.
Increased control: Shape your shots with precision and work the ball with ease.
Ideal for:
Golfers with fast swing speeds who seek a mid-launching, low-spinning driver shaft with exceptional stability and control. This shaft is perfect for players who want to maximize distance while maintaining accuracy and consistency.
Elevate your driver game with the Fujikura Motore X F3 shaft!
Note:
This shaft is designed for drivers and may not be suitable for fairway woods. It is always recommended to consult with a professional club fitter to determine the best shaft for your individual swing and game.

products.name: Bushnell Wingman Speaker Speaker
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Thanks to the new Wingman from Bushnell, golfers can get their music and their yardages from the same device. A truly unique product, the Wingman is a high-quality speaker that gives audible GPS distances to the front, middle, and back of the greens of over 36,000 courses worldwide. Perfectly designed for those who enjoy listening to some tunes out on the course, the Wingman allows golfers to do so without sacrificing their scores.
The Tech Story
The Bushnell Wingman boasts a detachable remote and integrated BITE magnetic technology that makes it easy to attach the device to a metal golf cart bar. With a rechargeable battery that provides up to 10 hours on a charge, golfers can typically rely on the Wingman for two full rounds. The device also features a USB port so that golfers using a golf cart with a USB compatibility can charge the Wingman during the round. Simply pair up the device with the free Bushnell golf app, and gain access to a treasure trove of courses around the globe. To get your distances, all golfers will have to do is press the Audible button to be given accurate distances to the front, center, and back of the green.

products.name: Oban Devotion HB High Balance Driver Shaft
products.description:
Who’s It For?
Golfers looking for a trajectory that produces a Mid launch with Low spin will find the Oban Devotion HB Driver Shaft well-suited to their needs. Its High Balance Medium-Firm Bend Profile is specifically engineered to create this launch and spin combination, which can help players achieve a strong, penetrating ball flight and maximize their distance off the tee while maintaining control.
The Tech Story
The Oban Devotion HB (High Balance) Driver Shaft represents a significant advancement within the esteemed Devotion Series, leveraging a strategic shift in the shaft's center of gravity towards the grip end to create a pronounced counter-balance effect that appeals to a wide spectrum of golfers, including Tour professionals. This innovative design ensures consistent stability and symmetry throughout the entirety of the golf swing, thereby optimizing the efficiency of energy transfer to the ball at the critical moment of impact for enhanced power and control. Featuring a Medium-Firm Bend Profile, the Devotion HB provides a high-performance option specifically engineered to complement and maximize the performance benefits of today's increasingly sophisticated driver head technologies, allowing players to fine-tune their launch conditions for peak results.
Facts and Figures
Shaft Profile: Medium-Firm Bend
Launch: Mid-High
Spin: Low-Mid
Butt Flex: Firm
Mid Flex: Medium
Tip Flex: Firm
